1.1: O the happiness of that one, who Has not walked in the counsel of the wicked. And in the way of sinners has not stood, And in the seat of scorners has not sat;
1.2: But--in the law of Jehovah is his delight, And in His law he does meditate by day and by night:
1.3: And he has been as a tree, Planted by rivulets of water, That gives its fruit in its season, And its leaf does not wither, And all that he does he causes to prosper.
1.4: Not so the wicked: But--as chaff that wind drives away!
1.5: Therefore the wicked rise not in judgment, Nor sinners in the company of the righteous,
1.6: For Jehovah is knowing the way of the righteous, And the way of the wicked is lost!

2.1: Why have nations tumultuously assembled? And do peoples meditate vanity?
2.2: Station themselves do kings of the earth, And princes have been united together, Against Jehovah, and against His Messiah:
2.3: `Let us draw off Their cords, And cast from us Their thick bands.'
2.4: He who is sitting in the heavens does laugh, The Lord does mock at them.
2.5: Then does He speak to them in His anger, And in His wrath He does trouble them:
2.6: `And I--I have anointed My King, Upon Zion--My holy hill.'
2.7: I declare concerning a statute: Jehovah said to me, `My Son You are, I to-day have brought you forth.
2.8: Ask of Me and I give nations--your inheritance, And your possession--the ends of earth.
2.9: You do rule them with a sceptre of iron, As a vessel of a potter You do crush them.'
2.10: And now, O kings, act wisely, Be instructed, O judges of earth,
2.11: Serve you Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.
2.12: Kiss the Chosen One, lest He be angry, And you lose the way, When His anger burns but a little, O the happiness of all trusting in Him!

3.1: A Psalm of David, in his fleeing from the face of Absalom his son. Jehovah, how have my distresses multiplied! Many are rising up against me.
3.2: Many are saying of my soul, `There is no salvation for him in God.' Selah.
3.3: And You, O Jehovah, are a shield for me, My honour, and lifter up of my head.
3.4: My voice is to Jehovah: I call: And He answers me from his holy hill, Selah.
3.5: I--I have lain down, and I sleep, I have waked, for Jehovah sustains me.
3.6: I am not afraid of myriads of people, That round about they have set against me.
3.7: Rise, O Jehovah! save me, my God. Because You have smitten All my enemies on the cheek. The teeth of the wicked You have broken.
3.8: Of Jehovah is this salvation; On Your people is Your blessing! Selah.

4.1: To the Overseer with Stringed Instruments. --A Psalm of David. In my calling answer You me, O God of my righteousness. In adversity You gave enlargement to me; Favour me, and hear my prayer.
4.2: Sons of men! till when is my glory for shame? You love a vain thing, you seek a lie. Selah.
4.3: And know you that Jehovah Has separated a saintly one to Himself. Jehovah hears in my calling to Him.
4.4: `Tremble you, and do not sin;' Say you thus in your heart on your bed, And be you silent. Selah.
4.5: Sacrifice you sacrifices of righteousness, And trust you to Jehovah.
4.6: Many are saying, `Who does show us good?' Lift on us the light of Your face, O Jehovah,
4.7: You have given joy in my heart, From the time their corn and their wine Have been multiplied.
4.8: In peace together I lie down and sleep, For You, O Jehovah, alone, In confidence do cause me to dwell!

5.1: To the Overseer, `Concerning the Inheritances.' --A Psalm of David. My sayings hear, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.
5.2: Be attentive to the voice of my cry, My king and my God, For to You I pray habitually.
5.3: Jehovah, at morning You hear my voice, At morning I set in array for You, And I look out.
5.4: For not a God desiring wickedness are You, Evil inhabits You not.
5.5: The boastful station not themselves before Your eyes: You have hated all working iniquity.
5.6: You destroy those speaking lies, A man of blood and deceit Jehovah does abominate.
5.7: And I, in the abundance of Your kindness, I enter Your house, I bow myself toward Your holy temple in Your fear.
5.8: O Jehovah, lead me in Your righteousness, Because of those observing me, Make straight before me Your way,
5.9: For there is no stability in their mouth. Their heart is mischiefs, An open grave is their throat, Their tongue they make smooth.
5.10: Declare them guilty, O God, Let them fall from their own counsels, In the abundance of their transgressions Drive them away, Because they have rebelled against You.
5.11: And rejoice do all trusting in You, To the age they sing, and You cover them over, And those loving Your name exult in You.
5.12: For You bless the righteous, O Jehovah, As a buckler with favour do compass him!

6.1: To the Overseer with stringed instruments, on the octave. --A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, in Your anger reprove me not, Nor in Your fury chastise me.
6.2: Favour me, O Jehovah, for I am weak, Heal me, O Jehovah, For troubled have been my bones,
6.3: And my soul has been troubled greatly, And You, O Jehovah, till when?
6.4: Turn back, O Jehovah, draw out my soul, Save me for Your kindness' sake.
6.5: For there is not in death Your memorial, In Sheol, who does give thanks to You?
6.6: I have been weary with my sighing, I meditate through all the night on my bed, With my tear my couch I waste.
6.7: Old from provocation is my eye, It is old because of all my adversaries,
6.8: Turn from me all you workers of iniquity, For Jehovah heard the voice of my weeping,
6.9: Jehovah has heard my supplication, Jehovah my prayer receives.
6.10: Ashamed and troubled greatly are all my enemies, They turn back--ashamed in a moment!

7.1: `The Erring One,' by David, that he sung to Jehovah concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite. O Jehovah, my God, in You I have trusted, Save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me.
7.2: Lest he tear as a lion my soul, Rending, and there is no deliverer.
7.3: O Jehovah, my God, if I have done this, If there is iniquity in my hands,
7.4: If I have done my well-wisher evil, And draw my adversary without cause,
7.5: An enemy pursues my soul, and overtakes, And treads down to the earth my life, And my honour places in the dust. Selah.
7.6: Rise, O Jehovah, in Your anger, Be lifted up at the wrath of my adversaries, And awake You for me: Judgment You have commanded:
7.7: And a company of peoples compass You, And over it on high turn You back,
7.8: Jehovah does judge the peoples; Judge me, O Jehovah, According to my righteousness, And according to my integrity on me,
7.9: Let, I pray You be ended the evil of the wicked, And establish You the righteous, And a trier of hearts and reins is the righteous God.
7.10: My shield is on God, Saviour of the upright in heart!
7.11: God is a righteous judge, And He is not angry at all times.
7.12: If one turn not, His sword he sharpens, His bow he has trodden--He prepares it,
7.13: Yes, for him He has prepared Instruments of death, His arrows for burning pursuers He makes.
7.14: Indeed, he travails with iniquity, And he has conceived perverseness, And has brought forth falsehood.
7.15: A pit he has prepared, and he digs it, And he falls into a ditch he makes.
7.16: Return does his perverseness on his head, And on his crown his violence comes down.
7.17: I thank Jehovah, According to His righteousness, And praise the name of Jehovah Most High!

8.1: To the Overseer, `On the Gittith.' A Psalm of David. Jehovah, our Lord, How honourable Your name in all the earth! Who sets your honour on the heavens.
8.2: From the mouths of infants and sucklings You have founded strength, Because of Your adversaries, To still an enemy and a self-avenger.
8.3: For I see Your heavens, a work of Your fingers, Moon and stars that You did establish.
8.4: What is man that You remember him? The son of man that You inspect him?
8.5: And cause him to lack a little of Godhead, And with honour and majesty compass him.
8.6: You do cause him to rule Over the works of Your hands, All You have placed under his feet.
8.7: Sheep and oxen, all of them, And also beasts of the field,
8.8: Bird of the heavens, and fish of the sea, Passing through the paths of the seas!
8.9: Jehovah, our Lord, How honourable Your name in all the earth!

9.1: To the Overseer, `On the Death of Labben.' --A Psalm of David. I confess, O Jehovah, with all my heart, I recount all Your wonders,
9.2: I rejoice and exult in You, I praise Your Name, O Most High.
9.3: In my enemies turning backward, they stumble and perish from Your face.
9.4: For You have done my judgment and my right. You have sat on a throne, A judge of righteousness.
9.5: You have rebuked nations, You have destroyed the wicked, Their name You have blotted out to the age and for ever.
9.6: O you Enemy, Finished have been destructions for ever, As to cities you have plucked up, Perished has their memorial with them.
9.7: And Jehovah to the age abides, He is preparing for judgment His throne.
9.8: And He judges the world in righteousness, He judges the peoples in uprightness.
9.9: And Jehovah is a tower for the bruised, A tower for times of adversity.
9.10: They trust in You who do know Your name, For You have not forsaken Those seeking You, O Jehovah.
9.11: Sing you praise to Jehovah, inhabiting Zion, Declare you among the peoples His acts,
9.12: For He who is seeking for blood Them has remembered, He has not forgotten the cry of the afflicted.
9.13: Favour me, O Jehovah, See my affliction by those hating me, You who lifts me up from the gates of death,
9.14: So that I recount all Your praise, In the gates of the daughter of Zion. I rejoice on Your salvation.
9.15: Sunk have nations in a pit they made, In a net that they hid has their foot been captured.
9.16: Jehovah has been known, Judgment He has done, By a work of his hands Has the wicked been snared. Meditation. Selah.
9.17: The wicked do turn back to Sheol, All nations forgetting God.
9.18: For not for ever is the needy forgotten, The hope of the humble lost to the age.
9.19: Rise, O Jehovah, let not man be strong, Let nations be judged before Your face.
9.20: Appoint, O Jehovah, a director to them, Let nations know they are men! Selah.

10.1: Why, Jehovah, do You stand at a distance? You do hide in times of adversity,
10.2: Through the pride of the wicked, Is the poor inflamed, They are caught in devices that they devised.
10.3: Because the wicked has boasted Of the desire of his soul, And a dishonest gainer he has blessed, He has despised Jehovah.
10.4: The wicked according to the height of his face, inquires not. `God is not!' are all his devices.
10.5: Pain do his ways at all times, On high are Your judgments before him, All his adversaries--he puffs at them.
10.6: He has said in his heart, `I am not moved,' To generation and generation not in evil.
10.7: Of oaths his mouth is full, And deceits, and fraud: Under his tongue is perverseness and iniquity,
10.8: He does sit in an ambush of the villages, In secret places he does slay the innocent. His eyes for the afflicted watch secretly,
10.9: He lies in wait in a secret place, as a lion in a covert. He lies in wait to catch the poor, He catches the poor, drawing him into his net.
10.10: He is bruised--he bows down, Fallen by his mighty ones has the afflicted.
10.11: He said in his heart, `God has forgotten, He has hid His face, He has never seen.'
10.12: Arise, O Jehovah! O God, lift up Your hand! Forget not the humble.
10.13: Wherefore has the wicked despised God? He has said in his heart, `It is not required.'
10.14: You have seen, For You perverseness and anger behold; By giving into Your hand, On You does the afflicted leave it, Of the fatherless You have been an helper.
10.15: Break the arm of the wicked and the evil, Seek out his wickedness, find none;
10.16: Jehovah is king to the age, and for ever, The nations have perished out of His land!
10.17: The desire of the humble You have heard, O Jehovah. You prepare their heart; You cause Your ear to attend,
10.18: To judge the fatherless and bruised: He adds no more to oppress--man of the earth!

11.1: To the Overseer. --By David. In Jehovah I trusted, how say you to my soul, `They moved to Your mountain for the bird?
11.2: For indeed, the wicked tread a bow, They have prepared their arrow on the string, To shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
11.3: When the foundations are destroyed, The righteous--what has he done?
11.4: `Jehovah is in his holy temple: Jehovah--in the heavens is His throne. His eyes see--His eyelids try the sons of men.
11.5: Jehovah the righteous does try. And the wicked and the lover of violence, Has His soul hated,
11.6: He pours on the wicked snares, fire, and brimstone, And a horrible wind is the portion of their cup.
11.7: For righteous is Jehovah, Righteousness He has loved, The upright does His countenance see!'

12.1: To the Overseer, on the octave. --A Psalm of David. Save, Jehovah, for the saintly has failed, For the stedfast have ceased From the sons of men:
12.2: Vanity they speak each with his neighbour, Lip of flattery! With heart and heart they speak.
12.3: Jehovah does cut off all lips of flattery, A tongue speaking great things,
12.4: Who said, `By our tongue we do mightily: Our lips are our own; who is lord over us?'
12.5: Because of the spoiling of the poor, Because of the groaning of the needy, Now do I arise, says Jehovah, I set in safety him who does breathe for it.
12.6: Sayings of Jehovah are pure sayings; Silver tried in a furnace of earth refined sevenfold.
12.7: You, O Jehovah, do preserve them, You keep us from this generation to the age.
12.8: Around the wicked walk continually, According as vileness is exalted by sons of men!

13.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. Till when, O Jehovah, Do You forget me? --for ever? Till when do You hide Your face from me?
13.2: Till when do I set counsels in my soul? Sorrow in my heart daily? Till when is my enemy exalted over me?
13.3: Look attentively; Answer me, O Jehovah, my God, Enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
13.4: Lest my enemy say, `I overcame him,' My adversaries joy when I am moved.
13.5: And I, in Your kindness I have trusted, Rejoice does my heart in Your salvation.
13.6: I do sing to Jehovah, For He has conferred benefits upon me!

14.1: To the Overseer. --By David. A fool has said in his heart, `God is not;' They have done corruptly, They have done abominable actions, There is not a doer of good.
14.2: Jehovah from the heavens Has looked on the sons of men, To see if there is a wise one--seeking God.
14.3: The whole have turned aside, Together they have been filthy: There is not a doer of good, not even one.
14.4: Have all working iniquity not known? Those consuming my people have eaten bread, Jehovah they have not called.
14.5: There they have feared a fear, For God is in the generation of the righteous.
14.6: The counsel of the poor you cause to stink, Because Jehovah is his refuge.
14.7: `Who does give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When Jehovah does turn back To a captivity of His people, Jacob does rejoice--Israel is glad!

15.1: A Psalm of David. Jehovah, who does sojourn in Your tent? Who does dwell in Your holy hill?
15.2: He who is walking uprightly, And working righteousness, And speaking truth in his heart.
15.3: He has not slandered by his tongue, He has not done to his friend evil; And reproach he has not lifted up Against his neighbour.
15.4: Despised in his eyes is a rejected one, And those fearing Jehovah he does honour. He has sworn to suffer evil, and changes not;
15.5: His silver he has not given in usury, And a bribe against the innocent Has not taken; Whoever is doing these is not moved to the age!

16.1: A Secret Treasure of David. Preserve me, O God, for I did trust in You.
16.2: You have said to Jehovah, `My Lord You are;' My good is not for your own sake;
16.3: For the holy ones who are in the land, And the honourable, all my delight is in them.
16.4: Multiplied are their griefs, Who have hastened backward; I pour not out their libations of blood, Nor do I take up their names on my lips.
16.5: Jehovah is the portion of my share, and of my cup, You--You do uphold my lot.
16.6: Lines have fallen to me in pleasant places, Yes, a beauteous inheritance is for me.
16.7: I bless Jehovah who has counselled me; Also in the nights my reins instruct me.
16.8: I did place Jehovah before me continually, Because--at my right hand I am not moved.
16.9: Therefore has my heart been glad, And my honour does rejoice, Also my flesh dwells confidently:
16.10: For You do not leave my soul to Sheol, Nor give your saintly one to see corruption.
16.11: You cause me to know the path of life; Fulness of joys is with Your presence, Pleasant things by Your right hand for ever!

17.1: A Prayer of David. Hear, O Jehovah, righteousness, attend my cry, Give ear to my prayer, without lips of deceit.
17.2: From before you my judgment does go out; Your eyes do see uprightly.
17.3: You have proved my heart, You have inspected by night, You have tried me, You find nothing; My thoughts pass not over my mouth.
17.4: As to doings of man, Through a word of Your lips I have observed The paths of a destroyer;
17.5: To uphold my goings in Your paths, My steps have not slidden.
17.6: I--I called You, for You do answer me, O God, incline Your ear to me, hear my speech.
17.7: Separate wonderfully Your kindness, O Saviour of the confiding, By Your right hand, from withstanders.
17.8: Keep me as the apple, the daughter of the eye; In shadow of Your wings you do hide me.
17.9: From the face of the wicked who spoiled me. My enemies in soul go round against me.
17.10: Their fat they have closed up, Their mouths have spoken with pride:
17.11: `Our steps now have compassed him;' Their eyes they set to turn aside in the land.
17.12: His likeness as a lion desirous to tear, As a young lion dwelling in secret places.
17.13: Arise, O Jehovah, go before his face, Cause him to bend. Deliver my soul from the wicked, Your sword,
17.14: From men, Your hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, their portion is in life, And with Your hidden things You fill their belly, They are satisfied with sons; And have left their abundance to their sucklings.
17.15: I--in righteousness, I see Your face; I am satisfied, in awaking, with Your form!

18.1: To the Overseer. --By a servant of Jehovah, by David, who has spoken to Jehovah the words of this song in the day Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul, and he says: --I love You, O Jehovah, my strength.
18.2: Jehovah is my rock, and my bulwark, And my deliverer, My God is my rock, I trust in Him: My shield, and a horn of my salvation, My high tower.
18.3: The `Praised One' I call Jehovah, And from my enemies I am saved.
18.4: Compassed me have cords of death, And streams of the worthless make me afraid.
18.5: Cords of Sheol have surrounded me, Before me have been snares of death.
18.6: In my adversity I call Jehovah, And to my God I cry. He hears from His temple my voice, And My cry before Him comes into His ears.
18.7: And shake and tremble does the earth, And foundations of hills are troubled, And they shake--because He has wrath.
18.8: Gone up has smoke by His nostrils, And fire from His mouth consumes, Coals have been kindled by it.
18.9: And He inclines the heavens, and comes down, And thick darkness is under His feet.
18.10: And He rides on a cherub, and does fly, And He flies on wings of wind.
18.11: He makes darkness His secret place, Round about Him His tabernacle, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
18.12: From the brightness over-against Him His thick clouds have passed on, Hail and coals of fire.
18.13: And thunder in the heavens does Jehovah, And the Most High gives forth His voice, Hail and coals of fire.
18.14: And He sends His arrows and scatters them, And much lightning, and crushes them.
18.15: And seen are the streams of waters, And revealed are foundations of the earth. From Your rebuke, O Jehovah, From the breath of the spirit of Your anger.
18.16: He sends from above--He takes me, He draws me out of many waters.
18.17: He delivers me from my strong enemy, And from those hating me, For they have been stronger than I.
18.18: They go before me in a day of my calamity And Jehovah is for a support to me.
18.19: And He brings me forth to a large place, He draws me out, because He delighted in me.
18.20: Jehovah does recompense me According to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands, He does return to me.
18.21: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not done wickedly against my God.
18.22: For all His judgments are before me, And His statutes I turn not from me.
18.23: And I am perfect with him, And I keep myself from my iniquity.
18.24: And Jehovah does return to me, According to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands, Over-against his eyes.
18.25: With the kind You show Yourself kind, With a perfect man show Yourself perfect.
18.26: With the pure You show Yourself pure, And with the perverse show Yourself a wrestler,
18.27: For You a poor people save, And the eyes of the high cause to fall.
18.28: For You--You light my lamp, Jehovah my God enlightens my darkness.
18.29: For by You I run--a troop! And by my God I leap a wall.
18.30: God! perfect is His way, The saying of Jehovah is tried, A shield is He to all those trusting in Him.
18.31: For who is God besides Jehovah? And who is a rock save our God?
18.32: God! who is girding me with strength, And He makes perfect my way.
18.33: Making my feet like hinds, And on my high places causes me to stand.
18.34: Teaching my hands for battle, And a bow of brass was brought down by my arms.
18.35: And You give to me the shield of Your salvation, And Your right hand does support me, And Your lowliness makes me great.
18.36: You enlarge my step under me, And my ankles have not slidden.
18.37: I pursue my enemies, and overtake them, And turn back not till they are consumed.
18.38: I smite them, and they are not able to rise, They fall under my feet,
18.39: And You gird me with strength for battle, Cause my withstanders to bow under me.
18.40: As to my enemies--You have given to me the neck, As to those hating me--I cut them off.
18.41: They cry, and there is no saviour, On Jehovah, and He does not answer them.
18.42: And I beat them as dust before wind, As mire of the streets I empty them out.
18.43: You do deliver me From the strivings of the people, You place me for a head of nations, A people I have not known do serve me.
18.44: At the hearing of the ear they hearken to me, Sons of a stranger feign obedience to me,
18.45: Sons of a stranger fade away, And are slain out of their close places.
18.46: Jehovah lives--and blessed is my rock, And exalted is the God of my salvation.
18.47: God--who is giving vengeance to me, And He subdues peoples under me,
18.48: My deliverer from my enemies, Above my withstanders You raise me, From a man of violence do deliver me.
18.49: Therefore I confess You among nations, O Jehovah, And to Your name I sing praise,
18.50: Magnifying the salvation of His king, And doing kindness to His anointed, To David, and to his seed--to the age!

19.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. The heavens are recounting the honour of God, And the work of His hands The expanse is declaring.
19.2: Day to day utters speech, And night to night shows knowledge.
19.3: There is no speech, and there are no words. Their voice has not been heard.
19.4: Into all the earth has their line gone forth, And to the end of the world their sayings, For the sun He placed a tent in them,
19.5: And he, as a bridegroom, goes out from his covering, He rejoices as a mighty one To run the path.
19.6: From the end of the heavens is his going out, And his revolution is to their ends, And nothing is hid from his heat.
19.7: The law of Jehovah is perfect, refreshing the soul, The testimonies of Jehovah are stedfast, Making wise the simple,
19.8: The precepts of Jehovah are upright, Rejoicing the heart, The command of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes,
19.9: The fear of Jehovah is clean, standing to the age, The judgments of Jehovah are true, They have been righteous--together.
19.10: They are more desirable than gold, Yes, than much fine gold; and sweeter than honey, Even liquid honey of the comb.
19.11: Also--Your servant is warned by them, `In keeping them is a great reward.'
19.12: Errors! who does understand? From hidden ones declare me innocent,
19.13: Also--from presumptuous ones keep back Your servant, Let them not rule over me, Then am I perfect, And declared innocent of much transgression,
19.14: Let the sayings of my mouth, And the meditation of my heart, Be for a pleasing thing before You, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer!

20.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. Jehovah does answer you, In a day of adversity, The name of the God of Jacob does set you on high,
20.2: He does send your help from the sanctuary, And from Zion does support you,
20.3: He does remember all your presents, And your burnt-offering does reduce to ashes. Selah.
20.4: He does give to you according to your heart, And all your counsel does fulfil.
20.5: We sing of your salvation, And in the name of our God set up a banner. Jehovah does fulfil all your requests.
20.6: Now I have known That Jehovah has saved His anointed, He answers him from His holy heavens, With the saving might of His right hand.
20.7: Some of chariots, and some of horses, And we of the name of Jehovah our God Make mention.
20.8: They--they have bowed and have fallen, And we have risen and station ourselves upright.
20.9: O Jehovah, save the king, He does answer us in the day we call!

21.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. Jehovah, in Your strength is the king joyful, In Your salvation how greatly he rejoices.
21.2: The desire of his heart You gave to him, And the request of his lips You have not withheld. Selah.
21.3: For You put before him blessings of goodness, You set on his head a crown of fine gold.
21.4: Life he has asked from You, You have given to him--length of days, Age-during--and for ever.
21.5: Great is his honour in Your salvation, Honour and majesty You place on him.
21.6: For You make him blessings for ever, You do cause him to rejoice with joy, By Your countenance.
21.7: For the king is trusting in Jehovah, And in the kindness of the Most High He is not moved.
21.8: Your hand comes to all Your enemies, Your right hand does find Your haters.
21.9: You make them as a furnace of fire, At the time of Your presence. Jehovah in His anger does swallow them, And fire does devour them.
21.10: Their fruit from earth You destroy, And their seed from the sons of men.
21.11: For they stretched out against You evil, They devised a wicked device, they prevail not,
21.12: For You make them a butt, When Your strings You prepare against their faces.
21.13: Be You exalted, O Jehovah in, Your strength, We sing and we praise Your might!

22.1: To the Overseer, on `The Hind of the Morning.' --A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Far from my salvation, The words of my roaring?
22.2: My God, I call by day, and You answer not, And by night, and there is no silence to me.
22.3: And You are holy, Sitting--the Praise of Israel.
22.4: In You did our fathers trust--they trusted, And You do deliver them.
22.5: To You they cried, and were delivered, In You they trusted, and were not ashamed.
22.6: And I am a worm, and no man, A reproach of man, and despised of the people.
22.7: All beholding me do mock at me, They make free with the lip--shake the head,
22.8: `Roll to Jehovah, He does deliver him, He does deliver him, for he delighted in him.'
22.9: For you are He bringing me forth from the womb, Causing me to trust, On the breasts of my mother.
22.10: On You I have been cast from the womb, From the belly of my mother You are my God.
22.11: Be not far from me, For adversity is near, for there is no helper.
22.12: Many bulls have surrounded me, Mighty ones of Bashan have compassed me,
22.13: They have opened against me their mouth, A lion tearing and roaring.
22.14: As waters I have been poured out, And separated themselves have all my bones, My heart has been like wax, It is melted in the midst of my bowels.
22.15: Dried up as an earthen vessel is my power, And my tongue is cleaving to my jaws.
22.16: And to the dust of death you appoint me, For surrounded me have dogs, A company of evil doers have compassed me, Piercing my hands and my feet.
22.17: I count all my bones--they look expectingly, They look upon me,
22.18: They apportion my garments to themselves, And for my clothing they cause a lot to fall.
22.19: And You, O Jehovah, be not far off, O my strength, to help me haste.
22.20: Deliver from the sword my soul, From the paw of a dog my only one.
22.21: Save me from the mouth of a lion: --And--from the horns of the high places You have answered me!
22.22: I declare Your name to my brethren, In the midst of the assembly I praise You.
22.23: You who fear Jehovah, praise you Him, All the seed of Jacob, honour you Him, And be afraid of Him, all you seed of Israel.
22.24: For He has not despised, nor abominated, The affliction of the afflicted, Nor has He hidden His face from him, And in his crying to Him He hears.
22.25: Of You my praise is in the great assembly. My vows I complete before His fearers.
22.26: The humble do eat and are satisfied, Praise Jehovah do those seeking Him, Your heart does live for ever.
22.27: Remember and return to Jehovah, Do all ends of the earth, And before You bow themselves, Do all families of the nations,
22.28: For to Jehovah is the kingdom, And He is ruling among nations.
22.29: And the fat ones of earth have eaten, And they bow themselves, Before Him bow do all going down to dust, And he who has not revived his soul.
22.30: A seed does serve Him, It is declared of the Lord to the generation.
22.31: They come and declare His righteousness, To a people that is borne, that He has made!

23.1: A Psalm of David. Jehovah is my shepherd, I do not lack,
23.2: In pastures of tender grass He causes me to lie down, By quiet waters He does lead me.
23.3: My soul He refreshes, He leads me in paths of righteousness, For His name's sake,
23.4: Also--when I walk in a valley of death-shade, I fear no evil, for You are with me, Your rod and Your staff--they comfort me.
23.5: You arrange before me a table, Over-against my adversaries, You have anointed with oil my head, My cup is full!
23.6: Only--goodness and kindness pursue me, All the days of my life, And my dwelling is in the house of Jehovah, For a length of days!

24.1: A Psalm of David. To Jehovah is the earth and its fulness, The world and the inhabitants in it.
24.2: For He on the seas has founded it, And on the floods He does establish it.
24.3: Who goes up into the hill of Jehovah? And who rises up in His holy place?
24.4: The clean of hands, and pure of heart, Who has not lifted up to vanity his soul, Nor has sworn to deceit.
24.5: He bears away a blessing from Jehovah, Righteousness from the God of his salvation.
24.6: This is a generation of those seeking Him. Seeking Your face, O Jacob! Selah.
24.7: Lift up, O gates, your heads, And be lifted up, O doors age-during, And come in does the king of glory!
24.8: Who is this--`the king of glory?' Jehovah--strong and mighty, Jehovah, the mighty in battle.
24.9: Lift up, O gates, your heads, And be lifted up, O doors age-during, And come in does the king of glory!
24.10: Who is He--this `king of glory?' Jehovah of hosts--He is the king of glory! Selah.

25.1: By David. To You, O Jehovah, my soul I lift up.
25.2: My God, in You I have trusted, Let me not be ashamed, Let not my enemies exult over me.
25.3: Also let none waiting on You be ashamed, Let the treacherous dealers without cause be ashamed.
25.4: Your ways, O Jehovah, cause me to know, Your paths teach You me.
25.5: Cause me to tread in Your truth, and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation, Near You I have waited all the day.
25.6: Remember Your mercies, O Jehovah, And Your kindnesses, for from the age are they.
25.7: Sins of my youth, and my transgressions, Do not You remember. According to Your kindness be mindful of me, For Your goodness' sake, O Jehovah.
25.8: Good and upright is Jehovah, Therefore He directs sinners in the way.
25.9: He causes the humble to tread in judgment, And teaches the humble His way.
25.10: All the paths of Jehovah are kindness and truth, To those keeping His covenant, And His testimonies.
25.11: For Your name's sake, O Jehovah, You have pardoned my iniquity, for it is great.
25.12: Who is this--the man fearing Jehovah? He directs him in the way He does choose.
25.13: His soul in good does remain, And his seed does possess the land.
25.14: The secret of Jehovah is for those fearing Him, And His covenant--to cause them to know.
25.15: My eyes are continually to Jehovah, For He brings out from a net my feet.
25.16: Turn You to me, and favour me, For lonely and afflicted am I.
25.17: The distresses of my heart have enlarged themselves, From my distresses bring me out.
25.18: See my affliction and my misery, And bear with all my sins.
25.19: See my enemies, for they have been many, And with violent hatred they have hated me.
25.20: Keep my soul, and deliver me, Let me not be ashamed, for I trusted in You.
25.21: Integrity and uprightness do keep me, For I have waited on You.
25.22: Redeem Israel, O God, from all his distresses!

26.1: By David. Judge me, O Jehovah, for I in my integrity have walked, And in Jehovah I have trusted, I slide not.
26.2: Try me, O Jehovah, and prove me, Purified are my reins and my heart.
26.3: For Your kindness is before my eyes, And I have walked habitually in Your truth.
26.4: I have not sat with vain men, And with dissemblers I enter not.
26.5: I have hated the assembly of evil doers, And with the wicked I sit not.
26.6: I wash in innocency my hands, And I compass Your altar, O Jehovah.
26.7: To sound with a voice of confession, And to recount all Your wonders.
26.8: Jehovah, I have loved the habitation of Your house, And the place of the tabernacle of Your honour.
26.9: Do not gather with sinners my soul, And with men of blood my life,
26.10: In whose hand is a wicked device, And their right hand is full of bribes.
26.11: And I, in my integrity I walk, Redeem me, and favour me.
26.12: My foot has stood in uprightness, In assemblies I bless Jehovah!

27.1: By David. Jehovah is my light and my salvation, Whom do I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life, Of whom am I afraid?
27.2: When evil doers come near to me to eat my flesh, My adversaries and my enemies to me, They have stumbled and fallen.
27.3: Though a host does encamp against me, My heart does not fear, Though war rises up against me, In this I am confident.
27.4: One thing I asked of Jehovah--it I seek. My dwelling in the house of Jehovah, All the days of my life, To look on the pleasantness of Jehovah, And to inquire in His temple.
27.5: For He hides me in a tabernacle in the day of evil, He hides me in a secret place of His tent, On a rock he raises me up.
27.6: And now, lifted up is my head, Above my enemies--my surrounders, And I sacrifice in His tent sacrifices of shouting, I sing, yes, I sing praise to Jehovah.
27.7: Hear, O Jehovah, my voice--I call, And favour me, and answer me.
27.8: To You said my heart `They sought my face, Your face, O Jehovah, I seek.'
27.9: Hide not Your face from me, Turn not aside in anger Your servant, My help You have been. Leave me not, nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.
27.10: When my father and my mother Have forsaken me, then does Jehovah gather me.
27.11: Show me, O Jehovah, Your way, And lead me in a path of uprightness, For the sake of my beholders.
27.12: Give me not to the will of my adversaries, For risen against me have false witnesses, And they breathe out violence to me.
27.13: I had not believed to look on the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living!
27.14: Look to Jehovah--be strong, And He does strengthen your heart, Yes, look to Jehovah!

28.1: By David. To You, O Jehovah, I call, My rock, be not silent to me! Lest You be silent to me, And I have been compared With those going down to the pit.
28.2: Hear the voice of my supplications, In my crying to You, In my lifting up my hands toward your holy oracle.
28.3: Draw me not with the wicked, And with workers of iniquity, Speaking peace with their neighbours, And evil in their heart.
28.4: Give to them according to their acting, And according to the evil of their doings. According to the work of their hands give to them. Return their deed to them.
28.5: For they attend not to the doing of Jehovah, And to the work of His hands. He throws them down, And does not build them up.
28.6: Blessed is Jehovah, For He has heard the voice of my supplications.
28.7: Jehovah is my strength, and my shield, In Him my heart trusted, and I have been helped. And my heart exults, And with my song I thank Him.
28.8: Jehovah is strength to him, Yes, the strength of the salvation of His anointed is He.
28.9: Save Your people, and bless Your inheritance, And feed them, and carry them to the age!

29.1: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to Jehovah, you sons of the mighty, Ascribe to Jehovah honour and strength.
29.2: Ascribe to Jehovah the honour of His name, Bow yourselves to Jehovah, In the beauty of holiness.
29.3: The voice of Jehovah is on the waters, The God of glory has thundered, Jehovah is on many waters.
29.4: The voice of Jehovah is with power, The voice of Jehovah is with majesty,
29.5: The voice of Jehovah is shivering cedars, Yes, Jehovah shivers the cedars of Lebanon.
29.6: And He causes them to skip as a calf, Lebanon and Sirion as a son of Reems,
29.7: The voice of Jehovah is hewing fiery flames,
29.8: The voice of Jehovah pains a wilderness, Jehovah pains the wilderness of Kadesh.
29.9: The voice of Jehovah pains the oaks, And makes bare the forests, And in His temple every one says, `Glory.'
29.10: Jehovah on the deluge has sat, And Jehovah sits king--to the age,
29.11: Jehovah strength to his people gives, Jehovah blesses His people with peace!

30.1: A Psalm. --A song of the dedication of the house of David. I exalt You, O Jehovah, For You have drawn me up, and have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
30.2: Jehovah my God, I have cried to You, And You do heal me.
30.3: Jehovah, You have brought up from Sheol my soul, You have kept me alive, From going down to the pit.
30.4: Sing praise to Jehovah, you His saints, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness,
30.5: For--a moment is in His anger, Life is in His good-will, At even remains weeping, and at morn singing.
30.6: And I--I have said in my ease, `I am not moved--to the age.
30.7: O Jehovah, in Your good pleasure, You have caused strength to remain for my mountain,' You have hidden Your face--I have been troubled.
30.8: To You, O Jehovah, I call, And to Jehovah I make supplication.
30.9: `What gain is in my blood? In my going down to corruption? Does dust thank You? does it declare Your truth?
30.10: Hear, O Jehovah, and favour me, O Jehovah, be a helper to me.'
30.11: You have turned my mourning to dancing for me, You have loosed my sackcloth, And gird me with joy.
30.12: So that honour does praise You, and is not silent, O Jehovah, my God, to the age I thank You!

31.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. In You, O Jehovah, I have trusted, Let me not be ashamed to the age, In Your righteousness deliver me.
31.2: Incline to me Your ear hastily, deliver me, Be to me for a strong rock, For a house of bulwarks to save me.
31.3: For my rock and my bulwark are You, For Your name's sake lead me and tend me.
31.4: Bring me out from the net that they hid for me, For You are my strength.
31.5: Into Your hand I commit my spirit, You have redeemed me, Jehovah God of truth.
31.6: I have hated the observers of lying vanities, And I toward Jehovah have been confident.
31.7: I rejoice, and am glad in Your kindness, In that You have seen my affliction, You have known in adversities my soul.
31.8: And You have not shut me up, Into the hand of an enemy, You have caused my feet to stand in a broad place.
31.9: Favour me, O Jehovah, for distress is to me, My eye, my soul, and my body Have become old by provocation.
31.10: For my life has been consumed in sorrow And my years in sighing. Feeble because of my iniquity has been my strength, And my bones have become old.
31.11: Among all my adversaries I have been a reproach, And to my neighbours exceedingly, And a fear to my acquaintances, Those seeing me without--fled from me.
31.12: I have been forgotten as dead out of mind, I have been as a perishing vessel.
31.13: For I have heard an evil account of many, Fear is round about. In their being united against me, To take my life they have devised,
31.14: And I on You--I have trusted, O Jehovah, I have said, `You are my God.'
31.15: In Your hand are my times, Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from my pursuers.
31.16: Cause Your face to shine on Your servant, Save me in Your kindness.
31.17: O Jehovah, let me not be ashamed, For I have called You, let the wicked be ashamed, Let them become silent to Sheol.
31.18: Let lips of falsehood become dumb, That are speaking against the righteous, Ancient sayings, in pride and contempt.
31.19: How abundant is Your goodness, That You have laid up for those fearing You,
31.20: You have worked for those trusting in You, Before sons of men. You hide them in the secret place of Your presence, From artifices of man, You conceal them in a tabernacle, From the strife of tongues.
31.21: Blessed is Jehovah, For He has made marvellous His kindness To me in a city of bulwarks.
31.22: And I--I have said in my haste, `I have been cut off from before Your eyes,' But You have heard the voice of my supplications, In my crying to You.
31.23: Love Jehovah, all you His saints, Jehovah is keeping the faithful, And recompensing abundantly a proud doer.
31.24: Be strong, and He strengthens your heart, All you who are waiting for Jehovah!

32.1: By David. --An Instruction. O the happiness of him whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
32.2: O the happiness of a man, To whom Jehovah imputes not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no deceit.
32.3: When I have kept silence, become old have my bones, Through my roaring all the day.
32.4: When by day and by night Your hand is heavy upon me, My moisture has been changed Into the droughts of summer. Selah.
32.5: My sin I cause You to know, And my iniquity I have not covered. I have said, `I confess concerning My transgressions to Jehovah,' And You--You have taken away, The iniquity of my sin. Selah.
32.6: For this does every saintly one pray to You, As the time to find. Surely at an overflowing of many waters, To him they come not.
32.7: You are a hiding-place for me, From distress You do keep me, With songs of deliverance do compass me. Selah.
32.8: I cause you to act wisely, And direct you in the way that you go, I cause my eye to take counsel concerning you.
32.9: Be you not as a horse--as a mule, Without understanding, With bridle and bit, its ornaments, to curb, Not to come near to you.
32.10: Many are the pains of the wicked; As to him who is trusting in Jehovah, Kindness does compass him.
32.11: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, you righteous, And sing, all you upright of heart!

33.1: Sing, you righteous, in Jehovah, For upright ones praise is comely.
33.2: Give you thanks to Jehovah with a harp, With psaltery of ten strings sing praise to Him,
33.3: Sing you to Him a new song, Play skilfully with shouting.
33.4: For upright is the word of Jehovah, And all His work is in faithfulness.
33.5: Loving righteousness and judgment, Of the kindness of Jehovah is the earth full.
33.6: By the word of Jehovah The heavens have been made, And by the breath of His mouth all their host.
33.7: Gathering as a heap the waters of the sea, Putting in treasuries the depths.
33.8: Afraid of Jehovah are all the earth, Of Him are all the inhabitants of the world afraid.
33.9: For He has said, and it is, He has commanded, and it stands.
33.10: Jehovah made void the counsel of nations, He disallowed the thoughts of the peoples.
33.11: The counsel of Jehovah to the age stands, The thoughts of His heart to all generations.
33.12: O the happiness of the nation whose God is Jehovah, Of the people He did choose, For an inheritance to Him.
33.13: From the heavens has Jehovah looked, He has seen all the sons of men.
33.14: From the fixed place of His dwelling, He looked to all inhabitants of the earth;
33.15: Who is forming their hearts together, Who is attending to all their works.
33.16: The king is not saved by the multitude of a force. A mighty man is not delivered, By abundance of power.
33.17: A false thing is the horse for safety, And by the abundance of his strength He does not deliver.
33.18: Indeed, the eye of Jehovah is to those fearing Him, To those waiting for His kindness,
33.19: To deliver from death their soul, And to keep them alive in famine.
33.20: Our soul has waited for Jehovah, Our help and our shield is He,
33.21: For in Him does our heart rejoice, For in His holy name we have trusted.
33.22: Let Your kindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, As we have waited for You!

34.1: By David, in his changing his behaviour before Abimelech, and he drives him away, and he goes. I do bless Jehovah at all times, Continually His praise is in my mouth.
34.2: In Jehovah does my soul boast herself, Hear do the humble and rejoice.
34.3: Ascribe you greatness to Jehovah with me, And we exalt His name together.
34.4: I sought Jehovah, and He answered me, And from all my fears did deliver me.
34.5: They looked expectingly to Him, And they became bright, And their faces are not ashamed.
34.6: This poor one called, and Jehovah heard, And from all his distresses saved him.
34.7: A messenger of Jehovah is encamping, Round about those who fear Him, And He arms them.
34.8: Taste you and see that Jehovah is good, O the happiness of the man who trusts in Him.
34.9: Fear Jehovah, you His holy ones, For there is no lack to those fearing Him.
34.10: Young lions have lacked and been hungry, And those seeking Jehovah lack not any good,
34.11: Come you, children, hearken to me, The fear of Jehovah I do teach you.
34.12: Who is the man that is desiring life? Loving days to see good?
34.13: Keep your tongue from evil, And your lips from speaking deceit.
34.14: Turn aside from evil and do good, Seek peace and pursue it.
34.15: The eyes of Jehovah are to the righteous, And His ears to their cry.
34.16: (The face of Jehovah is on doers of evil, To cut off from earth their memorial.)
34.17: They cried, and Jehovah heard, And from all their distresses delivered them.
34.18: Near is Jehovah to the broken of heart, And the bruised of spirit He saves.
34.19: Many are the evils of the righteous, Out of them all does Jehovah deliver him.
34.20: He is keeping all his bones, One of them has not been broken.
34.21: Evil does put to death the wicked, And those hating the righteous are desolate.
34.22: Jehovah redeems the soul of His servants, And none trusting in Him are desolate!

35.1: By David. Strive, Jehovah, with my strivers, fight with my fighters,
35.2: Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise for my help,
35.3: And draw out spear and lance, To meet my pursuers. Say to my soul, `Your salvation I am.'
35.4: They are ashamed and blush, those seeking my soul, Turned backward and confounded, Those devising my evil.
35.5: They are as chaff before wind, And a messenger of Jehovah driving away.
35.6: Their way is darkness and slipperiness, And a messenger of Jehovah their pursuer.
35.7: For without cause they hid for me their netpit, Without cause they digged for my soul.
35.8: Meet him does desolation--he knows not, And his net that he hid catches him, For desolation he falls into it.
35.9: And my soul is joyful in Jehovah, It rejoices in His salvation.
35.10: All my bones say, `Jehovah, who is like You, Delivering the poor from the stronger than he, And the poor and needy from his plunderer.'
35.11: Violent witnesses rise up, That which I have not known they ask me.
35.12: They pay me evil for good, bereaving my soul,
35.13: And I--in their sickness my clothing is sackcloth, I have humbled with fastings my soul, And my prayer to my bosom returns.
35.14: As if a friend, as if my brother, I walked habitually, As a mourner for a mother, Mourning I have bowed down.
35.15: And--in my halting they have rejoiced, And have been gathered together, Gathered against me were the smiters, And I have not known, They have rent, and they have not ceased;
35.16: With profane ones, mockers in feasts, Gnashing against me their teeth.
35.17: Lord, how long do you behold? Keep back my soul from their desolations, From young lions my only one.
35.18: I thank You in a great assembly, Among a mighty people I praise You.
35.19: My enemies rejoice not over me with falsehood, Those hating me without cause wink the eye.
35.20: For they speak not peace, And against the quiet of the land, Deceitful words they devise,
35.21: And they enlarge against me their mouth, They said, `Aha, aha, our eye has seen.'
35.22: You have seen, O Jehovah, Be not silent, O Lord--be not far from me,
35.23: Stir up, and wake to my judgment, My God, and my Lord, to my plea.
35.24: Judge me according to Your righteousness, O Jehovah my God, And they do not rejoice over me.
35.25: They do not say in their heart, `Aha, our desire.' They do not say, `We swallowed him up.'
35.26: They are ashamed and confounded together, Who are rejoicing at my evil. They put on shame and confusion, Who are magnifying themselves against me.
35.27: They sing and rejoice, who are desiring my righteousness, And they say continually, `Jehovah is magnified, Who is desiring the peace of His servant.'
35.28: And my tongue utters Your righteousness, All the day Your praise!

36.1: To the Overseer. --By a servant of Jehovah, by David. The transgression of the wicked Is affirming within my heart, `Fear of God is not before his eyes,
36.2: For he made it smooth to himself in his eyes, To find his iniquity to be hated.
36.3: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit, He ceased to act prudently--to do good.
36.4: Iniquity he devises on his bed, He stations himself on a way not good, Evil he does not refuse.'
36.5: O Jehovah, in the heavens is Your kindness, Your faithfulness is to the clouds.
36.6: Your righteousness is as mountains of God, Your judgments are a great deep. Man and beast You save, O Jehovah.
36.7: How precious is Your kindness, O God, And the sons of men In the shadow of Your wings do trust.
36.8: They are filled from the fatness of Your house, And the stream of Your delights You do cause them to drink.
36.9: For with You is a fountain of life, In Your light we see light.
36.10: Draw out Your kindness to those knowing You, And Your righteousness to the upright of heart.
36.11: Let not a foot of pride meet me, And a hand of the wicked let not move me.
36.12: There have workers of iniquity fallen, They have been overthrown, And have not been able to arise!

37.1: By David. Do not fret because of evil doers, Be not envious against doers of iniquity,
37.2: For as grass speedily they are cut off, And as the greenness of the tender grass do fade.
37.3: Trust in Jehovah, and do good, Dwell in the land, and enjoy faithfulness,
37.4: And delight yourself on Jehovah, And He gives to you the petitions of your heart.
37.5: Roll on Jehovah your way, And trust upon Him, and He works,
37.6: And has brought out as light your righteousness, And your judgment as noon-day.
37.7: Be silent for Jehovah, and stay yourself for Him, Do not fret because of him Who is making prosperous his way, Because of a man doing wicked devices.
37.8: Desist from anger, and forsake fury, Fret not yourself only to do evil.
37.9: For evil doers are cut off, As to those waiting on Jehovah, they possess the land.
37.10: And yet a little, and the wicked is not, And you have considered his place, and it is not.
37.11: And the humble do possess the land, And they have delighted themselves In the abundance of peace.
37.12: The wicked is devising against the righteous, And gnashing against him his teeth.
37.13: The Lord does laugh at him, For He has seen that his day comes.
37.14: A sword have the wicked opened, And they have trodden their bow, To cause to fall the poor and needy, To slaughter the upright of the way.
37.15: Their sword does enter into their own heart, And their bows are shivered.
37.16: Better is the little of the righteous, Than the store of many wicked.
37.17: For the arms of the wicked are shivered, And Jehovah is sustaining the righteous.
37.18: Jehovah knows the days of the perfect, And their inheritance is--to the age.
37.19: They are not ashamed in a time of evil, And in days of famine they are satisfied.
37.20: But the wicked perish, and the enemies of Jehovah, As the preciousness of lambs, Have been consumed, In smoke they have been consumed.
37.21: The wicked is borrowing and repays not, And the righteous is gracious and giving.
37.22: For His blessed ones do possess the land, And His reviled ones are cut off.
37.23: From Jehovah are the steps of a man, They have been prepared, And his way he desires.
37.24: When he falls, he is not cast down, For Jehovah is sustaining his hand.
37.25: Young I have been, I have also become old, And I have not seen the righteous forsaken, And his seed seeking bread.
37.26: All the day he is gracious and lending, And his seed is for a blessing.
37.27: Turn aside from evil, and do good, and dwell to the age.
37.28: For Jehovah is loving judgment, And He does not forsake His saintly ones, To the age they have been kept, And the seed of the wicked is cut off.
37.29: The righteous possess the land, And they dwell for ever on it.
37.30: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, And his tongue speaks judgment.
37.31: The law of his God is his heart, His steps do not slide.
37.32: The wicked is watching for the righteous, And is seeking to put him to death.
37.33: Jehovah does not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him in his being judged.
37.34: Look to Jehovah, and keep His way, And He does exalt you to possess the land, In the wicked being cut off--you see!
37.35: I have seen the wicked terrible, And spreading as a green native plant,
37.36: And he passes away, and indeed, he is not, And I seek him, and he is not found!
37.37: Observe the perfect, and see the upright, For the latter end of each is peace.
37.38: And transgressors were destroyed together, The latter end of the wicked was cut off.
37.39: And the salvation of the righteous is from Jehovah, Their strong place in a time of adversity.
37.40: And Jehovah does help them and deliver them, He delivers them from the wicked, And saves them, Because they trusted in Him!

38.1: A Psalm of David, `To cause to remember.' Jehovah, in Your wrath reprove me not, Nor in Your fury chastise me.
38.2: For Your arrows have come down on me, And You let down upon me Your hand.
38.3: Soundness is not in my flesh, Because of Your indignation, Peace is not in my bones because of my sin.
38.4: For my iniquities have passed over my head, As a heavy burden--too heavy for me.
38.5: Stunk--become corrupt have my wounds, Because of my folly.
38.6: I have been bent down, I have been bowed down--to excess, All the day I have gone mourning.
38.7: For my flanks have been full of drought, And soundness is not in my flesh.
38.8: I have been feeble and smitten--to excess, I have roared from disquietude of heart.
38.9: Lord, before You is all my desire, And my sighing from You has not been hid.
38.10: My heart is panting, my power has forsaken me, And the light of my eyes, Even they are not with me.
38.11: My lovers and my friends over-against my plague stand. And my neighbours afar off have stood.
38.12: And those seeking my soul lay a snare, And those seeking my evil Have spoken mischievous things, And they do deceits meditate all the day.
38.13: And I, as deaf, hear not. And as a dumb one who opens not his mouth.
38.14: Yes, I am as a man who hears not, And in his mouth are no reproofs.
38.15: Because for You, O Jehovah, I have waited, You do answer, O Lord my God.
38.16: When I said, `Lest they rejoice over me, In the slipping of my foot against me they magnified themselves.
38.17: For I am ready to halt, And my pain is before me continually.
38.18: For my iniquity I declare, I am sorry for my sin.
38.19: And my enemies are lively, They have been strong, and those hating me without cause, Have been multiplied.
38.20: And those paying evil for good accuse me, Because of my pursuing good.
38.21: Do not forsake me, O Jehovah, My God, be not far from me,
38.22: Haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!

39.1: To the Overseer, to Jeduthun. --A Psalm of David. I have said, `I observe my ways, Against sinning with my tongue, I keep for my mouth a curb, while the wicked is before me.'
39.2: I was dumb with silence, I kept silent from good, and my pain is excited.
39.3: Hot is my heart within me, In my meditating does the fire burn, I have spoken with my tongue.
39.4: `Cause me to know, O Jehovah, my end, And the measure of my days--what it is,' I know how frail I am.
39.5: Indeed, handbreadths You have made my days, And my age is as nothing before You, Only, all vanity is every man set up. Selah.
39.6: Only, in an image does each walk habitually, Only, in vain, they are disquieted, He heaps up and knows not who gathers them.
39.7: And, now, what have I expected? O Lord, my hope--it is of You.
39.8: From all my transgressions deliver me, A reproach of the fool make me not.
39.9: I have been dumb, I open not my mouth, Because You--You have done it.
39.10: Turn aside from off me Your stroke, From the striving of Your hand I have been consumed.
39.11: With reproofs against iniquity, You have corrected man, And do waste as a moth his desirableness, Only, vanity is every man. Selah.
39.12: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And to my cry give ear, To my tear be not silent, For a sojourner I am with You, A settler like all my fathers.
39.13: Look from me, and I brighten up before I go and am not!

40.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. I have diligently expected Jehovah, And He inclines to me, and hears my cry,
40.2: And He does cause me to come up From a pit of desolation--from mire of mud, And He raises up on a rock my feet, He is establishing my steps.
40.3: And He puts in my mouth a new song, `Praise to our God.' Many do see and fear, and trust in Jehovah.
40.4: O the happiness of the man Who has made Jehovah his trust, And has not turned to the proud, And those turning aside to lies.
40.5: Much have You done, Jehovah my God; Your wonders and Your thoughts toward us, There is none to arrange to You, I declare and speak: They have been more than to be numbered.
40.6: Sacrifice and present You have not desired, Ears You have prepared for me, Burnt and sin-offering You have not asked.
40.7: Then said I, `Indeed, I have come,' In the roll of the book it is written of me,
40.8: To do Your pleasure, my God, I have delighted, And Your law is within my heart.
40.9: I have proclaimed tidings of righteousness In the great assembly, indeed, my lips I restrain not, O Jehovah, You have known.
40.10: Your righteousness I have not concealed In the midst of my heart, Your faithfulness and Your salvation I have told, I have not hidden Your kindness and Your truth, To the great assembly.
40.11: You, O Jehovah, restrain not Your mercies from me, Your kindness and Your truth do continually keep me.
40.12: For compassed me have evils innumerable, Overtaken me have my iniquities, And I have not been able to see; They have been more than the hairs of my head, And my heart has forsaken me.
40.13: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me, O Jehovah, for my help make haste.
40.14: They are ashamed and confounded together, Who are seeking my soul to destroy it, They are turned backward, And are ashamed, who are desiring my evil.
40.15: They are desolate because of their shame, Who are saying to me, `Aha, aha.'
40.16: All seeking You rejoice and are glad in You, Those loving Your salvation say continually, `Jehovah is magnified.'
40.17: And I am poor and needy, The Lord does devise for me. My help and my deliverer are You, O my God, tarry You not.

41.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. O the happiness of him Who is acting wisely to the poor, In a day of evil does Jehovah deliver him.
41.2: Jehovah does preserve him and revive him, He is happy in the land, And You give him not into the will of his enemies.
41.3: Jehovah supports on a couch of sickness, All his bed You have turned in his weakness.
41.4: I--I said, `O Jehovah, favour me, Heal my soul, for I did sin against You,'
41.5: My enemies say evil of me: When he dies--his name has perished!
41.6: And if he came to see--vanity he speaks, His heart gathers iniquity to itself, He goes out--at the street he speaks.
41.7: All hating me whisper together against me, Against me they devise evil to me:
41.8: A thing of Belial is poured out on him, And because he lay down he rises not again.
41.9: Even my ally, in whom I trusted, One eating my bread, made great the heel against me,
41.10: And You, Jehovah, favour me, And cause me to rise, And I give recompence to them.
41.11: By this I have known, That You have delighted in me, Because my enemy shouts not over me.
41.12: As to me, in my integrity, You have taken hold upon me, And cause me to stand before You to the age.
41.13: Blessed is Jehovah, God of Israel, From the age--and to the age. Amen and Amen.

42.1: To the Overseer. --An Instruction. By sons of Korah. As a hart does pant for streams of water, So my soul pants toward You, O God.
42.2: My soul thirsted for God, for the living God, When do I enter and see the face of God?
42.3: My tear has been to me bread day and night, In their saying to me all the day, `Where is your God?'
42.4: These I remember, and pour out my soul in me, For I pass over into the booth, I go softly with them to the house of God, With the voice of singing and confession, The multitude keeping feast!
42.5: What! do you bow yourself, O my soul? Yes, are you troubled within me? Wait for God, for still I confess Him: The salvation of my countenance--My God!
42.6: In me does my soul bow itself, Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan, And of the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.
42.7: Deep to deep is calling At the noise of Your water-spouts, All Your breakers and Your billows passed over me.
42.8: By day Jehovah commands His kindness, And by night a song is with me, A prayer to the God of my life.
42.9: I say to God my rock, `Why have You forgotten me? Why go I mourning in the oppression of an enemy?
42.10: With a sword in my bones Have my adversaries reproached me, In their saying to me all the day, `Where is your God?'
42.11: What! do you bow yourself, O my soul? And what! are you troubled within me? Wait for God, for still I confess Him, The salvation of my countenance, and my God!

43.1: Judge me, O God, And plead my cause against a nation not pious, From a man of deceit and perverseness You do deliver me,
43.2: For you are the God of my strength. Why have You cast me off? Why mourning do I go up and down, In the oppression of an enemy?
43.3: Send forth Your light and Your truth, They--they lead me, they bring me in, To Your holy hill, and to Your tabernacles.
43.4: And I go in to the altar of God, To God, the joy of my rejoicing. And I thank You with a harp, O God, my God.
43.5: What! do you bow yourself, O my soul? And what! are you troubled within me? Wait for God, for still I confess Him, The salvation of my countenance, and my God!

44.1: To the Overseer. --By sons of Korah. An Instruction. O God, with our ears we have heard, Our fathers have recounted to us, The work You did work in their days, In the days of old.
44.2: You, with Your hand, nations have dispossessed. And You do plant them. You afflict peoples, and send them away.
44.3: For, not by their sword Possessed they the land, And their arm gave not salvation to them, But Your right hand, and Your arm, And the light of Your countenance, Because You had accepted them.
44.4: You are He, my king, O God, Command the deliverances of Jacob.
44.5: By You our adversaries we do push, By Your name tread down our withstanders,
44.6: For, not in my bow do I trust, And my sword does not save me.
44.7: For You have saved us from our adversaries, And those hating us You have put to shame.
44.8: In God we have boasted all the day, And Your name to the age we thank. Selah.
44.9: In anger You have cast off and cause us to blush, And go not forth with our hosts.
44.10: You cause us to turn backward from an adversary, And those hating us, Have spoiled for themselves.
44.11: You make us food like sheep, And among nations You have scattered us.
44.12: You sell Your people--without wealth, And have not become great by their price.
44.13: You make us a reproach to our neighbours, A scorn and a reproach to our surrounders.
44.14: You make us a simile among nations, A shaking of the head among peoples.
44.15: All the day my confusion is before me, And the shame of my face has covered me.
44.16: Because of the voice of a reproacher and reviler, Because of an enemy and a self-avenger.
44.17: All this met us, and we did not forget You, Nor have we dealt falsely in Your covenant.
44.18: We turn not backward our heart, Nor turn aside does our step from Your path.
44.19: But You have smitten us in a place of dragons, And do cover us over with death-shade.
44.20: If we have forgotten the name of our God, And spread our hands to a strange God,
44.21: Does not God search out this? For He knows the secrets of the heart.
44.22: Surely, for Your sake we have been slain all the day, Reckoned as sheep of the slaughter.
44.23: Stir up--why do You sleep, O Lord? Awake, cast us not off for ever.
44.24: Why Your face hide You? You forget our afflictions and our oppression,
44.25: For bowed to the dust has our soul, Cleaved to the earth has our belly.
44.26: Arise, a help to us, And ransom us for your kindness' sake.

45.1: To the Overseer. --`On the Lilies.' --By sons of Korah. --An Instruction. --A song of loves. My heart has indited a good thing, I am telling my works to a king, My tongue is the pen of a speedy writer.
45.2: You have been beautified above the sons of men, Grace has been poured into your lips, Therefore has God blessed you to the age.
45.3: Gird Your sword upon the thigh, O mighty, Your glory and Your majesty!
45.4: As to Your majesty--prosper! --ride! Because of truth, and meekness--righteousness, And Your right hand shows You fearful things.
45.5: Your arrows are sharp, --Peoples fall under You--In the heart of the enemies of the king.
45.6: Your throne, O God, is age-during, and for ever, A sceptre of uprightness Is the sceptre of Your kingdom.
45.7: You have loved righteousness and hate wickedness, Therefore God, your God, has anointed you, Oil of joy above your companions.
45.8: Myrrh and aloes, cassia! all your garments, Out of palaces of ivory Stringed instruments have made you glad.
45.9: Daughters of kings are among your precious ones, A queen has stood at your right hand, In pure gold of Ophir.
45.10: Hearken, O daughter, and see, incline your ear, And forget your people, and your father's house,
45.11: And the king does desire your beauty, Because he is your lord--bow yourself to him,
45.12: And the daughter of Tyre with a present, The rich of the people do appease your face.
45.13: All glory is the daughter of the king within, Of gold-embroidered work is her clothing.
45.14: In divers colours she is brought to the king, Virgins--after her--her companions, Are brought to you.
45.15: They are brought with joy and gladness, They come into the palace of the king.
45.16: Instead of your fathers are your sons, You do appoint them for princes in all the earth.
45.17: I make mention of Your name in all generations, Therefore do peoples praise You, To the age, and for ever!

46.1: To the Overseer. --By sons of Korah. `For the Virgins.' --A song. God is to us a refuge and strength, A help in adversities found most surely.
46.2: Therefore we fear not in the changing of earth, And in the slipping of mountains Into the heart of the seas.
46.3: Roar--troubled are its waters, Mountains they shake in its pride. Selah.
46.4: A river--its rivulets rejoice the city of God, Your holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.
46.5: God is in her midst--she is not moved, God does help her at the turn of the morn!
46.6: Troubled have been nations, Moved have been kingdoms, He has given forth with His voice, earth melts.
46.7: Jehovah of Hosts is with us, A tower for us is the God of Jacob. Selah.
46.8: Come you, see the works of Jehovah, Who has done astonishing things in the earth,
46.9: Causing wars to cease, To the end of the earth, the bow he shivers, And the spear He has cut asunder, Chariots he does burn with fire.
46.10: Desist, and know that I am God, I am exalted among nations, I am exalted in the earth.
46.11: Jehovah of hosts is with us, A tower for us is the God of Jacob! Selah.

47.1: To the Overseer. --By sons of Korah. A Psalm. All you peoples, clap the hand, Shout to God with a voice of singing,
47.2: For Jehovah Most High is fearful, A great king over all the earth.
47.3: He leads peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
47.4: He does choose for us our inheritance, The excellency of Jacob that He loves. Selah.
47.5: God has gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.
47.6: Praise God--praise--give praise to our king, praise.
47.7: For king of all the earth is God, Give praise, O understanding one.
47.8: God has reigned over nations, God has sat on His holy throne,
47.9: Nobles of peoples have been gathered, With the people of the God of Abraham, For to God are the shields of earth, Greatly has He been exalted!

48.1: A Song, a Psalm, by sons of Korah. Great is Jehovah, and praised greatly, In the city of our God--His holy hill.
48.2: Beautiful for elevation, A joy of all the land, is Mount Zion, The sides of the north, the city of a great king.
48.3: God in her high places is known for a tower.
48.4: For, indeed, the kings met, they passed by together,
48.5: They have seen--so they have marvelled, They have been troubled, they were hastened away.
48.6: Trembling has seized them there, Pain, as of a travailing woman.
48.7: By an east wind You shiver ships of Tarshish.
48.8: As we have heard, so we have seen, In the city of Jehovah of hosts, In the city of our God, God does establish her--to the age. Selah.
48.9: We have thought, O God, of Your kindness, In the midst of Your temple,
48.10: As is Your name, O God, so is Your praise, Over the ends of the earth, Righteousness has filled Your right hand.
48.11: Rejoice does Mount Zion, The daughters of Judah are joyful, For the sake of Your judgments.
48.12: Compass Zion, and go round her, count her towers,
48.13: Set your heart to her bulwark, Consider her high places, So that you recount to a later generation,
48.14: That this God is our God--To the age and for ever, He--he does lead us over death!

49.1: To the Overseer. --By sons of Korah. A Psalm. Hear this, all you peoples, Give ear, all you inhabitants of the world.
49.2: Both low and high, together rich and needy.
49.3: My mouth speaks wise things, And the meditations of my heart are things of understanding.
49.4: I incline to a simile my ear, I open with a harp my riddle:
49.5: Why do I fear in days of evil? The iniquity of my supplanters does compass me.
49.6: Those trusting on their wealth, And in the multitude of their riches, Do show themselves foolish.
49.7: A brother does no one at all ransom, He does not give to God his atonement.
49.8: And precious is the redemption of their soul, And it has ceased--to the age.
49.9: And still he lives for ever, He sees not the pit.
49.10: For he sees wise men die, Together the foolish and brutish perish, And have left to others their wealth.
49.11: Their heart is: Their houses are to the age, Their tabernacles to all generations. They proclaimed their names over the lands.
49.12: And man in honour does not remain, He has been like the beasts, they have been cut off.
49.13: This their way is folly for them, And their posterity with their sayings are pleased. Selah.
49.14: As sheep for Sheol they have set themselves, Death does afflict them, And the upright rule over them in the morning, And their form is for consumption. Sheol is a dwelling for him.
49.15: Only, God does ransom my soul from the hand of Sheol, For He does receive me. Selah.
49.16: Fear not, when one makes wealth, When the honour of his house is abundant,
49.17: For at his death he receives nothing, His honour goes not down after him.
49.18: For his soul in his life he blesses, (And they praise you when you do well for yourself.)
49.19: It comes to the generation of his fathers, For ever they see not the light.
49.20: Man in honour, who understand not, Has been like the beasts, they have been cut off!

50.1: A Psalm of Asaph. The God of gods--Jehovah--has spoken, And He calls to the earth From the rising of the sun to its going in.
50.2: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shone.
50.3: Our God comes, and is not silent, Fire before Him does devour, And round about him it has been very tempestuous.
50.4: He does call to the heavens from above, And to the earth, to judge His people.
50.5: Gather you to Me My saints, Making covenant with Me over a sacrifice.
50.6: And the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is judge. Selah.
50.7: Hear, O My people, and I speak, O Israel, and I testify against you, God, your God am I.
50.8: Not for your sacrifices do I reprove you, Yes, your burnt-offerings Are before Me continually.
50.9: I take not from your house a bullock, From your folds he goats.
50.10: For Mine is every beast of the forest, The cattle on the hills of oxen.
50.11: I have known every fowl of the mountains, And the wild beast of the field is with Me.
50.12: If I am hungry I tell not to you, For Mine is the world and its fulness.
50.13: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, And drink the blood of he-goats?
50.14: Sacrifice to God confession, And complete to the Most High your vows.
50.15: And call Me in a day of adversity, I deliver you, and you honour Me.
50.16: And to the wicked has God said: What to you--to recount My statutes? That you lift up My covenant on your mouth?
50.17: Yes, you have hated instruction, And do cast My words behind you.
50.18: If you have seen a thief, Then you are pleased with him, And with adulterers is your portion.
50.19: Your mouth you have sent forth with evil, And your tongue joins deceit together,
50.20: You sit, against your brother you speak, Against a son of your mother give slander.
50.21: These you did, and I kept silent, You have thought that I am like you, I reprove you, and set in array before your eyes.
50.22: Understand this, I pray you, You who are forgetting God, Lest I tear, and there is no deliverer.
50.23: He who is sacrificing praise honours Me, As to him who makes a way, I cause him to look on the salvation of God!

51.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David, in the coming in to him of Nathan the prophet, when he has gone in to Bath-Sheba. Favour me, O God, according to Your kindness, According to the abundance of Your mercies, Blot out my transgressions.
51.2: Thoroughly wash me from my iniquity, And from my sin cleanse me,
51.3: For my transgressions I do know, And my sin is before me continually.
51.4: Against You, You only, I have sinned, And done the evil thing in Your eyes, So that You are righteous in Your words, You are pure in Your judging.
51.5: Indeed, in iniquity I have been brought forth, And in sin does my mother conceive me.
51.6: Indeed, truth You have desired in the inward parts, And in the hidden part Wisdom You cause me to know.
51.7: You cleanse me with hyssop and I am clean, Wash me, and than snow I am whiter.
51.8: You cause me to hear joy and gladness, You make joyful bones You have bruised.
51.9: Hide Your face from my sin. And all my iniquities blot out.
51.10: A clean heart prepare for me, O God, And a right spirit renew within me.
51.11: Cast me not forth from Your presence, And Your Holy Spirit take not from me.
51.12: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And a willing spirit does sustain me.
51.13: I teach transgressors Your ways, And sinners to You do return.
51.14: Deliver me from blood, O God, God of my salvation, My tongue sings of Your righteousness.
51.15: O Lord, my lips you do open, And my mouth declares Your praise.
51.16: For You desire not sacrifice, or I give it, Burnt-offering You accept not.
51.17: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit, A heart broken and bruised, O God, You do not despise.
51.18: Do good in Your good pleasure with Zion, You do build the walls of Jerusalem.
51.19: Then You desire sacrifices of righteousness, Burnt-offering, and whole burnt-offering, Then they offer bullocks on your altar!

52.1: To the Overseer. --An instruction, by David, in the coming in of Doeg the Edomite, and he declares to Saul, and says to him, `David came in to the house of Ahimelech.' What, boasts you in evil, O mighty one? The kindness of God is all the day.
52.2: Mischiefs does your tongue devise, Like a sharp razor, working deceit.
52.3: You have loved evil rather than good, Lying, than speaking righteousness. Selah.
52.4: You have loved all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.
52.5: Also--God does break you down for ever, Takes you, and pulls you out of the tent, And He has uprooted you Out of the land of the living. Selah.
52.6: And the righteous see, And fear, and laugh at him.
52.7: `Indeed, the man who makes not God his strong place, And trusts in the abundance of his riches, He is strong in his mischiefs.'
52.8: And I, as a green olive in the house of God, I have trusted in the kindness of God, To the age and for ever,
52.9: I thank You to the age, because You have done it, And I wait on Your name for it is good before Your saints!

53.1: To the Overseer. --`On a disease.' --An instruction, by David. A fool said in his heart, `There is no God.' They have done corruptly, Yes, they have done abominable iniquity, There is none doing good.
53.2: God from the heavens looked on the sons of men, To see if there be an understanding one, One seeking God.
53.3: Every one went back, together they became filthy, There is none doing good--not even one.
53.4: Have not workers of iniquity known, Those eating my people have eaten bread, God they have not called.
53.5: There they feared a fear--there was no fear, For God has scattered the bones of him Who is encamping against you, You have put to shame, For God has despised them.
53.6: Who does give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When God turns back to a captivity of His people, Jacob does rejoice--Israel is glad!

54.1: To the Overseer with stringed instruments. --An instruction, by David, in the coming in of the Ziphim, and they say to Saul, `Is not David hiding himself with us?' O God, by Your name save me, and by Your might judge me.
54.2: O God, hear my prayer, Give ear to the sayings of my mouth,
54.3: For strangers have risen up against me And terrible ones have sought my soul, They have not set God before them. Selah.
54.4: Indeed, God is a helper to me, The Lord is with those supporting my soul,
54.5: Turn back does the evil thing to my enemies, In Your truth cut them off.
54.6: With a free will-offering I sacrifice to You, I thank Your name, O Jehovah, for it is good,
