103.16: For a wind has passed over it, and it is not, And its place does not discern it any more.
103.17: And the kindness of Jehovah Is from age even to age on those fearing Him, And His righteousness to sons' sons,
103.18: To those keeping His covenant, And to those remembering His precepts to do them.
103.19: Jehovah in the heavens Has established His throne, And His kingdom over all has ruled.
103.20: Bless Jehovah, you His messengers, Mighty in power--doing His word, To hearken to the voice of His Word.
103.21: Bless Jehovah, all you His hosts, His ministers--doing His pleasure.
103.22: Bless Jehovah, all you His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah!

104.1: Bless, O my soul, Jehovah! Jehovah, my God, You have been very great, Honour and majesty You have put on.
104.2: Covering himself with light as a garment, Stretching out the heavens as a curtain,
104.3: Who is laying the beam of His upper chambers in the waters, Who is making thick clouds His chariot, Who is walking on wings of wind,
104.4: Making His messengers--the winds, His ministers--the flaming fire.
104.5: He has founded earth on its bases, It is not moved to the age and for ever.
104.6: The abyss! as with clothing You have covered it, Above hills do waters stand.
104.7: From Your rebuke they flee, From the voice of Your thunder haste away.
104.8: They go up hills--they go down valleys, To a place You have founded for them.
104.9: A border You have set, they pass not over, They turn not back to cover the earth.
104.10: Who is sending forth fountains in valleys, Between hills they go on.
104.11: They water every beast of the field, Wild asses break their thirst.
104.12: By them the fowl of the heavens does dwell, From between the branches They give forth the voice.
104.13: Watering hills from His upper chambers, From the fruit of Your works is the earth satisfied.
104.14: Causing grass to spring up for cattle, And herb for the service of man, To bring forth bread from the earth,
104.15: And wine--it rejoices the heart of man, To cause the face to shine from oil, And bread--the heart of man it supports.
104.16: Satisfied are the trees of Jehovah, Cedars of Lebanon that He has planted,
104.17: Where birds do make nests, The stork--the firs are her house.
104.18: The high hills are for wild goats, Rocks are a refuge for conies,
104.19: He made the moon for seasons, The sun has known his place of entrance.
104.20: You set darkness, and it is night, In it does every beast of the forest creep.
104.21: The young lions are roaring for prey, And to seek from God their food.
104.22: The sun rises, they are gathered, And in their dens they crouch.
104.23: Man goes forth to his work, And to his service--till evening.
104.24: How many have been Your works, O Jehovah, All of them in wisdom You have made, Full is the earth of your possessions.
104.25: This, the sea, great and broad of sides, There are moving things--innumerable, Living creatures--small with great.
104.26: There do ships go: leviathan, That You have formed to play in it.
104.27: All of them to You do look, To give their food in its season.
104.28: You do give to them--they gather, You do open Your hand--they are satisfied with good.
104.29: You hide Your face--they are troubled, You gather their spirit--they expire, And to their dust they turn back.
104.30: You send out Your Spirit, they are created, And You renew the face of the ground.
104.31: The honour of Jehovah is to the age, Jehovah rejoices in His works,
104.32: Who is looking to earth, and it trembles, He comes against hills, and they smoke.
104.33: I sing to Jehovah during my life, I sing praise to my God while I exist.
104.34: Sweet is my meditation on Him, I--I do rejoice in Jehovah.
104.35: Consumed are sinners from the earth, And the wicked are no more. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah. Praise you Jehovah!

105.1: Give you thanks to Jehovah--call you in His name, Make known among the peoples His acts.
105.2: Sing you to Him--sing praise to Him, Meditate you on all His wonders.
105.3: Boast yourselves in His Holy Name, The heart of those seeking Jehovah rejoices.
105.4: Seek you Jehovah and His strength, Seek you His face continually.
105.5: Remember His wonders that He did, His signs and the judgments of His mouth.
105.6: O seed of Abraham, His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
105.7: He is Jehovah our God, In all the earth are His judgments.
105.8: He has remembered to the age His covenant, The word He commanded to a thousand generations,
105.9: That He has made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
105.10: And does establish it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel--a covenant age-during,
105.11: Saying, `To you I give the land of Canaan, The portion of your inheritance,'
105.12: In their being few in number, But a few, and sojourners in it.
105.13: And they go up and down, from nation to nation, From a kingdom to another people.
105.14: He has not suffered any to oppress them And He reproves for their sakes kings.
105.15: `Strike not against My anointed, And to My prophets do not evil.'
105.16: And He calls a famine on the land, The whole staff of bread He has broken.
105.17: He has sent before them a man, For a servant has Joseph been sold.
105.18: They have afflicted with fetters his feet, Iron has entered his soul,
105.19: Till the time of the coming of His word The saying of Jehovah has tried him.
105.20: The king has sent, and looses him, The ruler of the peoples, and draws him out.
105.21: He has made him lord of his house, And ruler over all his possessions.
105.22: To bind his chiefs at his pleasure, And his elders he makes wise.
105.23: And Israel comes in to Egypt, And Jacob has sojourned in the land of Ham.
105.24: And He makes His people very fruitful, And makes it mightier than its adversaries.
105.25: He turned their heart to hate His people, To conspire against His servants.
105.26: He has sent Moses His servant, Aaron whom He had fixed on.
105.27: They have set among them the matters of His signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
105.28: He has sent darkness, and it is dark, And they have not provoked His word.
105.29: He has turned their waters to blood, And puts to death their fish.
105.30: Teemed has their land with frogs, In the inner chambers of their kings.
105.31: He has said, and the beetle comes, Lice into all their border.
105.32: He has made their showers hail, A flaming fire is in their land.
105.33: And He smites their vine and their fig, And shivers the trees of their border.
105.34: He has said, and the locust comes, And the cankerworm--innumerable,
105.35: And it consumes every herb in their land, And it consumes the fruit of their ground.
105.36: And He smites every first-born in their land, The first-fruit of all their strength,
105.37: And brings them out with silver and gold, And there is not in its tribes a feeble one.
105.38: Rejoiced has Egypt in their going forth, For their fear had fallen upon them.
105.39: He has spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to enlighten the night.
105.40: They have asked, and He brings quails, And with bread of heaven satisfies them.
105.41: He has opened a rock, and waters issue, They have gone on in dry places--a river.
105.42: For He has remembered His holy word, With Abraham His servant,
105.43: And He brings forth His people with joy, With singing His chosen ones.
105.44: And He gives to them the lands of nations, And the labour of peoples they possess,
105.45: That they may observe His statutes, And His laws may keep. Praise you Jehovah!

106.1: Praise you Jah, give thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age, is His kindness.
106.2: Who does utter the mighty acts of Jehovah? Sounds all His praise?
106.3: O the happiness of those keeping judgment, Doing righteousness at all times.
106.4: Remember me, O Jehovah, With the favour of Your people, Look after me in Your salvation.
106.5: To look on the good of Your chosen ones, To rejoice in the joy of Your nation, To boast myself with Your inheritance.
106.6: We have sinned with our fathers, We have done perversely, we have done wickedly.
106.7: Our fathers in Egypt, Have not considered wisely Your wonders, They have not remembered The abundance of Your kind acts, And provoke by the sea, at the sea of Suph.
106.8: And He saves them for His name's sake, To make known His might,
106.9: And rebukes the sea of Suph, and it is dried up, And causes them to go Through depths as a wilderness.
106.10: And He saves them from the hand Of him who is hating, And redeems them from the hand of the enemy.
106.11: And waters cover their adversaries, One of them has not been left.
106.12: And they believe in His words, they sing His praise,
106.13: They have hasted--forgotten His works, They have not waited for His counsel.
106.14: And they lust greatly in a wilderness, And try God in a desert.
106.15: And He gives to them their request, And sends leanness into their soul.
106.16: And they are envious of Moses in the camp, Of Aaron, Jehovah's holy one.
106.17: Earth opens, and swallows up Dathan, And covers over the company of Abiram.
106.18: And fire burns among their company, A flame sets on fire the wicked.
106.19: They make a calf in Horeb, And bow themselves to a molten image,
106.20: And change their Honour Into the form of an ox eating herbs.
106.21: They have forgotten God their saviour, The doer of great things in Egypt,
106.22: Of wonderful things in the land of Ham, Of fearful things by the sea of Suph.
106.23: And He says to destroy them, Unless Moses, His chosen one, Had stood in the breach before Him, To turn back His wrath from destroying.
106.24: And they kick against the desirable land, They have not given credence to His word.
106.25: And they murmur in their tents, They have not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah.
106.26: And He lifts up His hand to them, To cause them to fall in a wilderness,
106.27: And to cause their seed to fall among nations, And to scatter them through lands.
106.28: And they are coupled to Baal-Peor, And eat the sacrifices of the dead,
106.29: And they provoke to anger by their actions, And a plague breaks forth upon them,
106.30: And Phinehas stands, and executes judgment, And the plague is restrained,
106.31: And it is reckoned to him to righteousness, To all generations--to the age.
106.32: And they cause wrath by the waters of Meribah, And it is evil to Moses for their sakes,
106.33: For they have provoked his spirit, And he speaks wrongfully with his lips.
106.34: They have not destroyed the peoples, As Jehovah had said to them,
106.35: And mix themselves among nations, and learn their works,
106.36: And serve their idols, And they are to them for a snare.
106.37: And they sacrifice their sons And their daughters to destroyers,
106.38: And they shed innocent blood--Blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they have sacrificed to idols of Canaan, And the land is profaned with blood.
106.39: And they are defiled with their works, And commit whoredom in their habitual doings.
106.40: And the anger of Jehovah Is kindled against His people, And He does abominate His inheritance.
106.41: And gives them into the hand of nations, And those hating them rule over them,
106.42: And their enemies oppress them, And they are humbled under their hand.
106.43: Many times He does deliver them, And they rebel in their counsel, And they are brought low in their iniquity.
106.44: And He looks on their distress When He hears their cry,
106.45: And remembers for them His covenant, And is comforted, According to the abundance of His kindness.
106.46: And He appoints them for mercies Before all their captors.
106.47: Save us, O Jehovah our God, and gather us from the nations, To give thanks to Your holy name, To glory in Your praise.
106.48: Blessed is Jehovah, God of Israel, From the age even to the age. And all the people said, `Amen, praise Jah!'

107.1: `Give you thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age is His kindness:'
107.2: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say, Whom He redeemed from the hand of an adversary.
107.3: And from the lands has gathered them, From east and from west, From north, and from the sea.
107.4: They wandered in a wilderness, in a desert by the way, A city of habitation they have not found.
107.5: Hungry--yes--thirsty, Their soul in them becomes feeble,
107.6: And they cry to Jehovah in their adversity, From their distress He delivers them,
107.7: And causes them to tread in a right way, To go to a city of habitation.
107.8: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men.
107.9: For He has satisfied a longing soul, And a hungry soul has filled with goodness.
107.10: Inhabitants of dark places and death-shade, Prisoners of affliction and of iron,
107.11: Because they changed the saying of God, And the counsel of the Most High despised.
107.12: And He humbles with labour their heart, They have been feeble, and there is no helper.
107.13: And they cry to Jehovah in their adversity, From their distresses He saves them.
107.14: He brings them out from the dark place, And death-shade, And their bands He draws away.
107.15: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men.
107.16: For He has broken doors of brass, And bars of iron He has cut.
107.17: Fools, by means of their transgression, And by their iniquities, afflict themselves.
107.18: All food does their soul abominate, And they come nigh to the gates of death,
107.19: And cry to Jehovah in their adversity, From their distresses He saves them,
107.20: He sends His word and heals them, And delivers from their destructions.
107.21: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men,
107.22: And they sacrifice sacrifices of thanksgiving, And recount His works with singing.
107.23: Those going down to the sea in ships, Doing business in many waters,
107.24: They have seen the works of Jehovah, And His wonders in the deep.
107.25: And He says, and appoints a tempest, And it lifts up its billows,
107.26: They go up to the heavens, they go down to the depths, Their soul in evil is melted.
107.27: They reel to and fro, and move as a drunkard, And all their wisdom is swallowed up.
107.28: And they cry to Jehovah in their adversity, And from their distresses He brings them out.
107.29: He establishes a whirlwind to a calm, And hushed are their billows.
107.30: And they rejoice because they are quiet, And He leads them to the haven of their desire.
107.31: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men,
107.32: And they exalt Him in the assembly of the people, And in the seat of the elders praise Him.
107.33: He makes rivers become a wilderness, And fountains of waters become dry land.
107.34: A fruitful land becomes a barren place, For the wickedness of its inhabitants.
107.35: He makes a wilderness become a pool of water, And a dry land become fountains of waters.
107.36: And He causes the hungry to dwell there, And they prepare a city of habitation.
107.37: And they sow fields, and plant vineyards, And they make fruits of increase.
107.38: And He blesses them, and they multiply exceedingly, And their cattle He does not diminish.
107.39: And they are diminished, and bow down, By restraint, evil, and sorrow.
107.40: He is pouring contempt upon nobles, And causes them to wander in vacancy--no way.
107.41: And sets on high the needy from affliction, And places families as a flock.
107.42: The upright do see and rejoice, And all perversity has shut her mouth.
107.43: Who is wise, and observes these? They understand the kind acts of Jehovah!

108.1: A Song, a Psalm of David. Prepared is my heart, O God, I sing, yes, I sing praise, also my honour.
108.2: Awake, psaltery and harp, I awake the dawn.
108.3: I thank You among peoples, O Jehovah, And I praise You among the nations.
108.4: For great above the heavens is Your kindness, And to the clouds Your truth.
108.5: Be You exalted above the heavens, O God, And above all the earth Your honour.
108.6: That Your beloved ones may be delivered, Save with Your right hand, and answer us.
108.7: God has spoken in His holiness: I exult, I apportion Shechem, And the valley of Succoth I measure,
108.8: Mine is Gilead, mine is Manasseh, And Ephraim is the strength of my head, Judah is my lawgiver,
108.9: Moab is a pot for my washing, Upon Edom I cast my shoe, Over Philistia I shout habitually.
108.10: Who does bring me in to the fenced city? Who has led me to Edom?
108.11: Have not You, O God, cast us off? And You go not out, O God, with our hosts!
108.12: Give to us help from adversity, And vain is the salvation of man.
108.13: In God we do mightily, And He does tread down our adversaries!

109.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent,
109.2: For the mouth of wickedness, and the mouth of deceit, Against me they have opened, They have spoken with me--A tongue of falsehood, and words of hatred!
109.3: They have compassed me about, And they fight me without cause.
109.4: For my love they oppose me, and I--prayer!
109.5: And they set against me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
109.6: Appoint You over him the wicked, And an adversary stands at his right hand.
109.7: In his being judged, he goes forth wicked, And his prayer is for sin.
109.8: His days are few, his oversight another takes,
109.9: His sons are fatherless, and his wife a widow.
109.10: And wander continually do his sons, Yes, they have begged, And have sought out of their dry places.
109.11: An exactor lays a snare for all that he has, And strangers spoil his labour.
109.12: He has none to extend kindness, Nor is there one showing favour to his orphans.
109.13: His posterity is for cutting off, In another generation is their name blotted out.
109.14: The iniquity of his fathers Is remembered to Jehovah, And the sin of his mother is not blotted out.
109.15: They are before Jehovah continually, And He cuts off from earth their memorial.
109.16: Because that he has not remembered to do kindness, And pursues the poor man and needy, And the smitten of heart--to slay,
109.17: And he loves reviling, and it meets him, And he has not delighted in blessing, And it is far from him.
109.18: And he puts on reviling as his robe, And it comes in as water into his midst, And as oil into his bones.
109.19: It is to him as apparel--he covers himself, And for a continual girdle he girds it on.
109.20: This is the wage of my accusers from Jehovah, And of those speaking evil against my soul.
109.21: And You, O Jehovah Lord, Deal with me for Your name's sake, Because Your kindness is good, deliver me.
109.22: For I am poor and needy, And my heart has been pierced in my midst.
109.23: As a shadow when it is stretched out I have gone, I have been driven away as a locust.
109.24: My knees have been feeble from fasting, And my flesh has failed of fatness.
109.25: And I--I have been a reproach to them, They see me, they shake their head.
109.26: Help me, O Jehovah my God, Save me, according to Your kindness.
109.27: And they know that this is Your hand, You, O Jehovah, You have done it.
109.28: They revile, and You do bless, They have risen, and are ashamed, And Your servant does rejoice.
109.29: My accusers put on blushing, and are covered, As an upper robe is their shame.
109.30: I thank Jehovah greatly with my mouth, And in the midst of many I praise Him,
109.31: For He stands at the right hand of the needy, To save from those judging his soul.

110.1: A Psalm of David. The affirmation of Jehovah to my Lord: `Sit at My right hand, Till I make your enemies your footstool.'
110.2: The rod of your strength does Jehovah send from Zion, Rule in the midst of your enemies.
110.3: Your people are free-will gifts in the day of Your strength, in the honours of holiness, From the womb, from the morning, You have the dew of your youth.
110.4: Jehovah has sworn, and does not repent, `You are a priest to the age, According to the order of Melchizedek.'
110.5: The Lord on your right hand smote kings In the day of His anger.
110.6: He does judge among the nations, He has completed the carcases, Has smitten the head over the mighty earth.
110.7: From a brook in the way he drinks, Therefore he does lift up the head!

111.1: Praise you Jah! I thank Jehovah with the whole heart, In the secret meeting of the upright, And of the company.
111.2: Great are the works of Jehovah, Sought out by all desiring them.
111.3: Honourable and majestic is His work, And His righteousness is standing for ever.
111.4: A memorial He has made of His wonders, Gracious and merciful is Jehovah.
111.5: Prey He has given to those fearing Him, He remembers to the age His covenant.
111.6: The power of His works He has declared to His people, To give to them the inheritance of nations.
111.7: The works of His hands are true and just, Stedfast are all His appointments.
111.8: They are sustained for ever to the age. They are made in truth and uprightness.
111.9: Redemption He has sent to His people, He has appointed to the age His covenant, Holy and fearful is His name.
111.10: The beginning of wisdom is fear of Jehovah, Good understanding have all doing them, His praise is standing for ever!

112.1: Praise you Jah! O the happiness of one fearing Jehovah, In His commands he has delighted greatly.
112.2: Mighty in the earth is his seed, The generation of the upright is blessed.
112.3: Wealth and riches are in his house, And his righteousness is standing for ever.
112.4: Light has risen in darkness to the upright, Gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
112.5: Good is the man--gracious and lending, He sustains his matters in judgment.
112.6: For--to the age he is not moved; For a memorial age-during is the righteous.
112.7: Of an evil report he is not afraid, Prepared is His heart, confident in Jehovah.
112.8: Sustained is his heart--he fears not, Till that he look on his adversaries.
112.9: He has scattered--has given to the needy, His righteousness is standing for ever, His horn is exalted with honour.
112.10: The wicked sees, and has been angry, His teeth he gnashes, and has melted, The desire of the wicked does perish!

113.1: Praise you Jah! Praise, you servants of Jehovah. Praise the name of Jehovah.
113.2: The name of Jehovah is blessed, From now, and to the age.
113.3: From the rising of the sun to its going in, Praised is the name of Jehovah.
113.4: High above all nations is Jehovah, Above the heavens is his honour.
113.5: Who is as Jehovah our God, He is exalting Himself to sit?
113.6: He is humbling Himself to look On the heavens and on the earth.
113.7: He is raising up from the dust the poor, From a dunghill He exalts the needy.
113.8: To cause to sit with princes, With the princes of His people.
113.9: Causing the barren one of the house to sit, A joyful mother of sons; praise you Jah!

114.1: In the going out of Israel from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a strange people,
114.2: Judah became His sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
114.3: The sea has seen, and flees, The Jordan turns backward.
114.4: The mountains have skipped as rams, Heights as sons of a flock.
114.5: What--to you, O sea, that you flee? O Jordan, you turn back!
114.6: O mountains, you skip as rams! O heights, as sons of a flock!
114.7: From before the Lord be afraid, O earth, From before the God of Jacob,
114.8: He is turning the rock to a pool of waters, The flint to a fountain of waters!

115.1: Not to us, O Jehovah, not to us, But to Your name give honour, For Your kindness, for Your truth.
115.2: Why do the nations say, `Where, pray, is their God.
115.3: And our God is in the heavens, All that He has pleased He has done.
115.4: Their idols are silver and gold, work of man's hands,
115.5: A mouth they have, and they speak not, Eyes they have, and they see not,
115.6: Ears they have, and they hear not, A nose they have, and they smell not,
115.7: Their hands, but they handle not, Their feet, and they walk not;
115.8: Nor do they mutter through their throat, Like them are their makers, Every one who is trusting in them.
115.9: O Israel, trust in Jehovah, `Their help and their shield is He.'
115.10: O house of Aaron, trust in Jehovah, `Their help and their shield is He.'
115.11: You fearing Jehovah, trust in Jehovah, `Their help and their shield is He.'
115.12: Jehovah has remembered us, He blesses, He blesses the house of Israel, He blesses the house of Aaron,
115.13: He blesses those fearing Jehovah, The small with the great.
115.14: Jehovah adds to you, to you, and to your sons.
115.15: Blessed are you of Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,
115.16: The heavens--the heavens are Jehovah's, And the earth He has given to sons of men,
115.17: The dead praise not Jah, Nor any going down to silence.
115.18: And we, we bless Jah, From now, and to the age. Praise you Jah!

116.1: I have loved, because Jehovah hears My voice, my supplication,
116.2: Because He has inclined His ear to me, And during my days I call.
116.3: Compassed me have cords of death, And straits of Sheol have found me, Distress and sorrow I find.
116.4: And in the name of Jehovah I call: I pray You, O Jehovah, deliver my soul,
116.5: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous, Yes, our God is merciful,
116.6: A preserver of the simple is Jehovah, I was low, and to me He gives salvation.
116.7: Turn back, O my soul, to your rest, For Jehovah has conferred benefits on you.
116.8: For You have delivered my soul from death, My eyes from tears, my feet from overthrowing.
116.9: I walk habitually before Jehovah In the lands of the living.
116.10: I have believed, for I speak, I--I have been afflicted greatly.
116.11: I said in my haste, `Every man is a liar.'
116.12: What do I return to Jehovah? All His benefits are upon me.
116.13: The cup of salvation I lift up, And in the name of Jehovah I call.
116.14: My vows to Jehovah let me complete, I pray you, before all His people.
116.15: Precious in the eyes of Jehovah is the death for His saints.
116.16: Cause it to come, O Jehovah, for I am Your servant. I am Your servant, son of Your handmaid, You have opened my bonds.
116.17: To You I sacrifice a sacrifice of thanks, And in the name of Jehovah I call.
116.18: My vows to Jehovah let me complete, I pray you, before all His people,
116.19: In the courts of the house of Jehovah, In your midst, O Jerusalem, praise you Jah!

117.1: Praise Jehovah, all you nations, Glorify Him, all you peoples.
117.2: For mighty to us has been His kindness, And the truth of Jehovah is to the age. Praise you Jah!

118.1: Give you thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age is His kindness.
118.2: I pray you, let Israel say, That, to the age is His kindness.
118.3: I pray you, let the house of Aaron say, That, to the age is His kindness.
118.4: I pray you, let those fearing Jehovah say, That, to the age is His kindness.
118.5: From the straitness I called Jah, Jah answered me in a broad place.
118.6: Jehovah is for me, I do not fear what man does to me.
118.7: Jehovah is for me among my helpers, And I--I look on those hating me.
118.8: Better to take refuge in Jehovah than to trust in man,
118.9: Better to take refuge in Jehovah, Than to trust in princes.
118.10: All nations have compassed me about, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.
118.11: They have compassed me about, Yes, they have compassed me about, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.
118.12: They compassed me about as bees, They have been extinguished as a fire of thorns, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.
118.13: You have sorely thrust me to fall, And Jehovah has helped me.
118.14: My strength and song is Jah, And He is to me for salvation.
118.15: A voice of singing and salvation, Is in the tents of the righteous, The right hand of Jehovah is doing valiantly.
118.16: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, The right hand of Jehovah is doing valiantly.
118.17: I do not die, but live, And recount the works of Jah,
118.18: Jah has sorely chastened me, And to death has not given me up.
118.19: Open you to me gates of righteousness, I enter into them--I thank Jah.
118.20: This is the gate to Jehovah, The righteous enter into it.
118.21: I thank You, for You have answered me, And are to me for salvation.
118.22: A stone the builders refused Has become head of a corner.
118.23: From Jehovah has this been, It is wonderful in our eyes,
118.24: This is the day Jehovah has made, We rejoice and are glad in it.
118.25: I beseech You, O Jehovah, save, I pray You, I beseech You, O Jehovah, prosper, I pray You.
118.26: Blessed is he who is coming In the name of Jehovah, We blessed you from the house of Jehovah,
118.27: God is Jehovah, and He gives to us light, Direct you the festal-sacrifice with cords, To the horns of the altar.
118.28: My God You are, and I confess You, My God, I exalt You.
118.29: Give you thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age, is His kindness!

119.1: Aleph. O the happiness of those perfect in the way, They are walking in the law of Jehovah,
119.2: O the happiness of those keeping His testimonies, With the whole heart they seek Him.
119.3: Yes, they have not done iniquity, In His ways they have walked.
119.4: You have commanded us Your precepts to keep diligently,
119.5: O that my ways were prepared to keep Your statutes,
119.6: Then I am not ashamed In my looking to all Your commands.
119.7: I confess You with uprightness of heart, In my learning the judgments of Your righteousness.
119.8: Your statutes I keep, leave me not utterly!
119.9: Beth. With what does a young man purify his path? To observe--according to Your word.
119.10: With all my heart I have sought You, Let me not err from Your commands.
119.11: In my heart I have hid Your saying, That I sin not before You.
119.12: Blessed are You, O Jehovah, teach me Your statutes.
119.13: With my lips I have recounted All the judgments of Your mouth.
119.14: In the way of Your testimonies I have joyed, As over all wealth.
119.15: In Your precepts I meditate, And I behold attentively Your paths.
119.16: In Your statutes I delight myself, I do not forget Your word.
119.17: Gimel. Confer benefits on Your servant, I live, and I keep Your word.
119.18: Uncover my eyes, and I behold wonders out of Your law.
119.19: A sojourner I am on earth, Hide not from me Your commands.
119.20: Broken has my soul for desire To Your judgments at all times.
119.21: You have rebuked the cursed proud, Who are erring from Your commands.
119.22: Remove from me reproach and contempt, For Your testimonies I have kept.
119.23: Princes also sat--against me they spoke, Your servant does meditate in Your statutes,
119.24: Your testimonies also are my delight, The men of my counsel!
119.25: Dales. Cleaved to the dust has my soul, Quicken me according to Your word.
119.26: My ways I have recounted, And You answer me, teach me Your statutes,
119.27: The way of Your precepts cause me to understand, And I meditate in Your wonders.
119.28: My soul has dropped from affliction, Establish me according to Your word.
119.29: The way of falsehood turn aside from me And with Your law favour me.
119.30: The way of faithfulness I have chosen, Your judgments I have compared,
119.31: I have adhered to Your testimonies, O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
119.32: The way of Your commands I run, For You do enlarge my heart!
119.33: He. Show me, O Jehovah, the way of Your statutes, And I keep it-- to the end.
119.34: Cause me to understand, and I keep Your law, And observe it with the whole heart.
119.35: Cause me to tread in the path of Your commands, For in it I have delighted.
119.36: Incline my heart to Your testimonies, And not to dishon gain.
119.37: Remove my eyes from seeing vanity, In Your way quicken You me.
119.38: Establish to Your servant Your saying, That is concerning Your fear.
119.39: Remove my reproach that I have feared, For Your judgments are good.
119.40: Indeed, I have longed for Your precepts, In Your righteousness quicken You me,
119.41: Waw. And meet me does Your kindness, O Jehovah, Your salvation according to Your saying.
119.42: And I answer him who is reproaching me a word, For I have trusted in Your word.
119.43: And You take not utterly away From my mouth the word of truth, Because for Your judgment I have hoped.
119.44: And I keep Your law continually, To the age and for ever.
119.45: And I walk habitually in a broad place, For Your precepts I have sought.
119.46: And I speak of Your testimonies before kings, And I am not ashamed.
119.47: And I delight myself in Your commands, That I have loved,
119.48: And I lift up my hands to Your commands, That I have loved, And I do meditate on Your statutes!
119.49: Zain. Remember the word to Your servant, On which You have caused me to hope.
119.50: This is my comfort in my affliction, That Your saying has quickened me.
119.51: The proud have utterly scorned me, From Your law I have not turned aside.
119.52: I remembered Your judgments of old, O Jehovah, And I comfort myself.
119.53: Horror has seized me, Because of the wicked forsaking Your law.
119.54: Songs have been to me Your statutes, In the house of my sojournings.
119.55: I have remembered in the night Your name, O Jehovah, And I do keep Your law.
119.56: This has been to me, That Your precepts I have kept!
119.57: Cheth. My portion is Jehovah; I have said--to keep Your words,
119.58: I appeased Your face with the whole heart, Favour me according to Your saying.
119.59: I have reckoned my ways, And turn back my feet to Your testimonies.
119.60: I have made haste, And delayed not, to keep Your commands.
119.61: Cords of the wicked have surrounded me, Your law I have not forgotten.
119.62: At midnight I rise to give thanks to You, For the judgments of Your righteousness.
119.63: A companion I am to all who fear You, And to those keeping Your precepts.
119.64: Of Your kindness, O Jehovah, the earth is full, Your statutes teach You me!
119.65: Teth. Good You did with Your servant, O Jehovah, According to Your word.
119.66: The goodness of reason and knowledge teach me, For in Your commands I have believed.
119.67: Before I am afflicted, I--I am erring, And now Your saying I have kept.
119.68: Good You are, and doing good, Teach me Your statutes.
119.69: Forged against me falsehood have the proud, I with the whole heart keep Your precepts.
119.70: Insensate as fat has been their heart, I--in Your law I have delighted.
119.71: Good for me that I have been afflicted, That I might learn Your statutes.
119.72: Better to me is the law of Your mouth Than thousands of gold and silver!
119.73: Yod. Your hands made me and establish me, Cause me to understand, and I learn Your commands.
119.74: Those fearing You see me and rejoice, Because for Your word I have hoped.
119.75: I have known, O Jehovah, That righteous are Your judgments, And in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
119.76: Let, I pray You, Your kindness be to comfort me, According to Your saying to Your servant.
119.77: Meet me do Your mercies, and I live, For Your law is my delight.
119.78: Ashamed are the proud, For with falsehood they dealt perversely with me. I meditate in Your precepts.
119.79: Those fearing You turn back to me, And those knowing Your testimonies.
119.80: My heart is perfect in Your statutes, So that I am not ashamed.
119.81: Kaph. Consumed for Your salvation has been my soul, For Your word I have hoped.
119.82: Consumed have been my eyes for Your word, Saying, `When does it comfort me?'
119.83: For I have been as a bottle in smoke, Your statutes I have not forgotten.
119.84: How many are the days of Your servant? When do You execute Against my pursuers judgment?
119.85: The proud have digged for me pits, That are not according to Your law.
119.86: All Your commands are faithfulness, With falsehood they have pursued me, Help You me.
119.87: Almost consumed me on earth have they, And I--I have not forsaken Your precepts.
119.88: According to Your kindness quicken You me, And I keep the testimony of Your mouth!
119.89: Lamed. To the age, O Jehovah, Your word is set up in the heavens.
119.90: To all generations Your faithfulness, You did establish earth, and it stands.
119.91: According to Your ordinances They have stood this day, for the whole are Your servants.
119.92: Unless Your law were my delights, Then had I perished in my affliction.
119.93: To the age I forget not Your precepts, For by them You have quickened me.
119.94: I am Yours, save You me, For Your precepts I have sought.
119.95: Your wicked waited for me to destroy me, Your testimonies I understand.
119.96: Of all perfection I have seen an end, Broad is Your command--exceedingly!
119.97: Mem. O how I have loved Your law! All the day it is my meditation.
119.98: Than my enemies Your command makes me wiser, For it is before me to the age.
119.99: Above all my teachers I have acted wisely. For Your testimonies are my meditation.
119.100: Above elders I understand more, For Your precepts I have kept.
119.101: From every evil path I restrained my feet, So that I keep Your word.
119.102: From Your judgments I turned not aside, For You--You have directed me.
119.103: How sweet to my palate has been Your saying, Above honey to my mouth.
119.104: From Your precepts I have understanding, Therefore I have hated every false path!
119.105: Nun. A lamp to my foot is Your word, And a light to my path.
119.106: I have sworn, and I confirm it, To keep the judgments of Your righteousness.
119.107: I have been afflicted very much, O Jehovah, quicken me, according to Your word.
119.108: Free-will-offerings of my mouth, Accept, I pray You, O Jehovah, And Your judgments teach You me.
119.109: My soul is in my hand continually, And Your law I have not forgotten.
119.110: The wicked have laid a snare for me, And from your precepts I wandered not.
119.111: I have inherited Your testimonies to the age, For the joy of my heart are they.
119.112: I have inclined my heart To do Your statutes, to the age-- to the end!
119.113: Samech. Doubting ones I have hated, And Your law I have loved.
119.114: My hiding place and my shield are You, For Your word I have hoped.
119.115: Turn aside from me, you evil-doers, And I keep the commands of my God.
119.116: Sustain me according to Your saying, And I live, and You put me not to shame Because of my hope.
119.117: Support You me, and I am saved, And I look on Your statutes continually.
119.118: You have trodden down All going astray from Your statutes, For falsehood is their deceit.
119.119: Dross! You have caused to cease All the wicked of the earth; Therefore I have loved Your testimonies.
119.120: Trembled from Your fear has my flesh, And from Your judgments I have been afraid!
119.121: Ain. I have done judgment and righteousness, Leave me not to my oppressors.
119.122: Make sure Your servant for good, Let not the proud oppress me.
119.123: My eyes have been consumed for Your salvation. And for the saying of Your righteousness.
119.124: Do with Your servant according to Your kindness. And Your statutes teach You me.
119.125: Your servant am I--cause me to understand, And I know Your testimonies.
119.126: Time for Jehovah to work! they have made void Your law.
119.127: Therefore I have loved Your commands Above gold--even fine gold.
119.128: Therefore all my appointments I have declared wholly right, Every path of falsehood I have hated!
119.129: Pe. Wonderful are Your testimonies, Therefore has my soul kept them.
119.130: The opening of Your words enlightens, Instructing the simple.
119.131: My mouth I have opened, yes, I pant, For, for Your commands I have longed.
119.132: Look to me, and favour me, As customary to those loving Your name.
119.133: My steps establish by Your saying, And any iniquity does not rule over me.
119.134: Ransom me from the oppression of man, And I observe Your precepts,
119.135: Your face cause to shine on Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.
119.136: Rivulets of waters have come down my eyes, Because they have not kept Your law!
119.137: Tzade. Righteous are You, O Jehovah, And upright are Your judgments.
119.138: You have appointed Your testimonies, Righteous and exceeding faithful,
119.139: Cut me off has my zeal, For my adversaries forgot Your words.
119.140: Tried is your saying exceedingly, And Your servant has loved it.
119.141: Small I am, and despised, Your precepts I have not forgotten.
119.142: Your righteousness is righteousness to the age, And Your law is truth.
119.143: Adversity and distress have found me, Your commands are my delights.
119.144: The righteousness of Your testimonies is to Cause me to understand, and I live!
119.145: Koph. I have called with the whole heart, Answer me, O Jehovah, Your statutes I keep,
119.146: I have called You, save You me, And I do keep Your testimonies.
119.147: I have gone forward in the dawn, and I cry, For Your word I have hoped.
119.148: My eyes have gone before the watches, To meditate in Your saying.
119.149: My voice hear, according to Your kindness, Jehovah, according to Your judgment quicken me.
119.150: Near have been my wicked pursuers, From Your law they have been far off.
119.151: Near are You, O Jehovah, And all Your commands are truth.
119.152: Of old I have known Your testimonies, That to the age You have founded them!
119.153: Resh. See my affliction, and deliver You me, For Your law I have not forgotten.
119.154: Plead my plea, and redeem me, According to Your saying quicken me.
119.155: Far from the wicked is salvation, For Your statutes they have not sought.
119.156: Your mercies are many, O Jehovah, According to Your judgments quicken me.
119.157: Many are my pursuers, and adversaries, From Your testimonies I have not turned aside.
119.158: I have seen treacherous ones, And grieve myself, Because Your saying they have not kept.
119.159: See, for your precepts I have loved, Jehovah, According to Your kindness quicken me.
119.160: The sum of Your word is truth, And to the age is every judgment of Your righteousness!
119.161: Shin. Princes have pursued me without cause, And because of Your words was my heart afraid.
119.162: I do rejoice concerning Your saying, As one finding abundant spoil.
119.163: Falsehood I have hated, yes I abominate it, Your law I have loved.
119.164: Seven times in a day I have praised You, Because of the judgments of Your righteousness.
119.165: Abundant peace have those loving Your law, And they have no stumbling-block.
119.166: I have waited for Your salvation, O Jehovah, And Your commands I have done.
119.167: Kept has my soul Your testimonies, And I do love them exceedingly.
119.168: I have kept Your precepts and Your testimonies, For all my ways are before You!
119.169: Taw. My loud cry comes near before You, O Jehovah; According to Your word cause me to understand.
119.170: My supplication comes in before You, According to Your saying deliver You me.
119.171: My lips do utter praise, For You do teach me Your statutes.
119.172: My tongue does sing of Your saying, For all Your commands are righteous.
119.173: Your hand is for a help to me, For Your commands I have chosen.
119.174: I have longed for Your salvation, O Jehovah, And Your law is my delight.
119.175: My soul lives, and it does praise You, And Your judgments do help me.
119.176: I wandered as a lost sheep, seek Your servant, For Your precepts I have not forgotten!

120.1: A Song of the Ascents. To Jehovah in my distress I have called, And He answers me.
120.2: O Jehovah, deliver my soul from a lying lip, From a deceitful tongue!
120.3: What does He give to you? And what does He add to you? O deceitful tongue!
120.4: Sharp arrows of a mighty one, with broom-coals.
120.5: Woe to me, for I have inhabited Mesech, I have dwelt with tents of Kedar.
120.6: Too much has my soul dwelt with him who is hating peace.
120.7: I am peace, and when I speak they are for war!

121.1: A Song of the Ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills, From where does my help come?
121.2: My help is from Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,
121.3: He suffers not your foot to be moved, Your preserver slumbers not.
121.4: Indeed, He slumbers not, nor sleeps, He who is preserving Israel.
121.5: Jehovah is your preserver, Jehovah is your shade on your right hand,
121.6: By day the sun does not smite you, Nor the moon by night.
121.7: Jehovah preserves you from all evil, He does preserve your soul.
121.8: Jehovah preserves your going out and your coming in, From now even to the age!

122.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. I have rejoiced in those saying to me, `To the house of Jehovah we go.'
122.2: Our feet have been standing in your gates, O Jerusalem!
122.3: Jerusalem--the builded one-- Is as a city that is joined to itself together.
122.4: For there have tribes gone up, Tribes of Jah, companies of Israel, To give thanks to the name of Jehovah.
122.5: For there have sat thrones of judgment, Thrones of the house of David.
122.6: Ask you the peace of Jerusalem, At rest are those loving you.
122.7: Peace is in your bulwark, rest in your high places,
122.8: For the sake of my brethren and my companions, Let me speak, I pray you, `Peace be in you.'
122.9: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God, I seek good for you!

123.1: A Song of the Ascents. To You I have lifted up my eyes, O dweller in the heavens.
123.2: Indeed, as eyes of men-servants Are to the hand of their masters, As eyes of a maid-servant Are to the hand of her mistress, So are our eyes to Jehovah our God, Till that He does favour us.
123.3: Favour us, O Jehovah, favour us, For greatly have we been filled with contempt,
123.4: Greatly has our soul been filled With the scorning of the easy ones, With the contempt of the arrogant!

124.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. Save for Jehovah--who has been for us, (Pray, let Israel say),
124.2: Save for Jehovah--who has been for us, In the rising up of man against us,
124.3: Then alive they had swallowed us up, In the burning of their anger against us,
124.4: Then the waters had overflowed us, The stream passed over our soul,
124.5: Then passed over our soul had the proud waters.
124.6: Blessed is Jehovah who has not given us, A prey to their teeth.
124.7: Our soul as a bird has escaped from a snare of fowlers, The snare was broken, and we have escaped.
124.8: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Maker of the heavens and earth!

125.1: A Song of the Ascents. Those trusting in Jehovah are as Mount Zion, It is not moved--to the age it abides.
125.2: Jerusalem! mountains are round about her, And Jehovah is round about His people, From now even to the age.
125.3: For the rod of wickedness rests not On the lot of the righteous, That the righteous put not forth on iniquity their hands.
125.4: Do good, O Jehovah, to the good, And to the upright in their hearts.
125.5: As to those turning to their crooked ways, Jehovah causes them to go with workers of iniquity. Peace on Israel!

126.1: A Song of the Ascents. In Jehovah's turning back to the captivity of Zion, We have been as dreamers.
126.2: Then filled with laughter is our mouth, And our tongue with singing, Then do they say among nations, `Jehovah did great things with these.'
126.3: Jehovah did great things with us, We have been joyful.
126.4: Turn again, O Jehovah, to our captivity, As streams in the south.
126.5: Those sowing in tears, with singing do reap,
126.6: Whoever goes on and weeps, Bearing the basket of seed, Surely comes in with singing, bearing his sheaves!

127.1: A Song of the Ascents, by Solomon. If Jehovah does not build the house, In vain have its builders laboured at it, If Jehovah does not watch a city, In vain has a watchman waked.
127.2: Vain for you who are rising early, Who delay sitting, eating the bread of griefs, So He gives to His beloved one sleep.
127.3: Indeed, an inheritance of Jehovah are sons, A reward is the fruit of the womb.
127.4: As arrows in the hand of a mighty one, So are the sons of the young men.
127.5: O the happiness of the man Who has filled his quiver with them, They are not ashamed, For they speak with enemies in the gate!

128.1: A Song of the Ascents. O the happiness of every one fearing Jehovah, Who is walking in His ways.
128.2: The labour of your hands you surely eat, Happy are you, and good is to you.
128.3: Your wife is as a fruitful vine in the sides of your house, Your sons as olive plants around your table.
128.4: Indeed, surely thus is the man blessed who is fearing Jehovah.
128.5: Jehovah does bless you out of Zion, Look, then, on the good of Jerusalem, All the days of your life,
128.6: And see the sons of your sons! Peace on Israel!

129.1: A Song of the Ascents. Often they distressed me from my youth, Pray, let Israel say:
129.2: Often they distressed me from my youth, Yet they have not prevailed over me.
129.3: Over my back have ploughers ploughed, They have made long their furrows.
129.4: Jehovah is righteous, He has cut asunder cords of the wicked.
129.5: Confounded and turn backward do all hating Zion.
129.6: They are as grass of the roofs, That before it was drawn out withers,
129.7: That has not filled the hand of a reaper, And the bosom of a binder of sheaves.
129.8: And the passers by have not said, `The blessing of Jehovah is on you, We blessed you in the Name of Jehovah!'

130.1: A Song of the Ascents. From depths I have called You, Jehovah.
130.2: Lord, hearken to my voice, Your ears are attentive to the voice of my supplications.
130.3: If iniquities You do observe, O Lord, who does stand?
130.4: But with You is forgiveness, that You may be feared.
130.5: I hoped for Jehovah--hoped has my soul, And for His word I have waited.
130.6: My soul is for the Lord, More than those watching for morning, Watching for morning!
130.7: Israel does wait on Jehovah, For with Jehovah is kindness, And abundant with Him is redemption.
130.8: And He does redeem Israel from all his iniquities!

131.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. Jehovah, my heart has not been haughty, Nor have my eyes been high, Nor have I walked in great things, And in things too wonderful for me.
131.2: Have I not compared, and kept silent my soul, As a weaned one by its mother? As a weaned one by me is my soul.
131.3: Israel does wait on Jehovah, From now, and to the age!

132.1: A Song of the Ascents. Remember, Jehovah, for David, all his afflictions.
132.2: Who has sworn to Jehovah. He has vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
132.3: `If I enter into the tent of my house, If I go up on the couch of my bed,
132.4: If I give sleep to my eyes, To my eyelids--slumber,
132.5: Till I do find a place for Jehovah, Tabernacles for the Mighty One of Jacob.
132.6: `Indeed, we have heard it in Ephratah, We have found it in the fields of the forest.
132.7: We come in to His tabernacles, We bow ourselves at His footstool.
132.8: Arise, O Jehovah, to Your rest, You, and the ark of Your strength,
132.9: Your priests do put on righteousness, And Your pious ones cry aloud.
132.10: For the sake of David Your servant, Turn not back the face of Your anointed.
132.11: Jehovah has sworn truth to David, He turns not back from it: Of the fruit of your body, I set on the throne for you.
132.12: If your sons keep My covenant, And My testimonies that I teach them, Their sons also for ever and ever, Do sit on the throne for you.
132.13: For Jehovah has fixed on Zion, He has desired it for a seat to Himself,
132.14: This is My rest for ever and ever, Here do I sit, for I have desired it.
132.15: Her provision I greatly bless, Her needy ones I satisfy with bread,
132.16: And her priests I clothe with salvation, And her pious ones do sing aloud.
132.17: There I cause to spring up a horn for David, I have arranged a lamp for My anointed.
132.18: His enemies I do clothe with shame, And upon him does his crown flourish!

133.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. Indeed, how good and how pleasant The dwelling of brethren--even together!
133.2: As the good oil on the head, Coming down on the beard, the beard of Aaron, That comes down on the skirt of his robes,
133.3: As dew of Hermon--That comes down on hills of Zion, For there Jehovah commanded the blessing--Life to the age!

134.1: A Song of the Ascents. Indeed, bless Jehovah, all servants of Jehovah, Who are standing in the house of Jehovah by night.
134.2: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, And bless you Jehovah.
134.3: Jehovah does bless you out of Zion, The maker of the heavens and earth!

135.1: Praise you Jah! Praise you the name of Jehovah, Praise, you servants of Jehovah,
135.2: Who are standing in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.
135.3: Praise you Jah! for Jehovah is good, Sing praise to His name, for it is pleasant.
135.4: For Jacob has Jah chosen for Himself, Israel for His peculiar treasure.
135.5: For I have known that great is Jehovah, Yes, our Lord is above all gods.
135.6: All that Jehovah pleased He has done, In the heavens and in earth, In the seas and all deep places,
135.7: Causing vapours to ascend from the end of the earth, Lightnings for the rain He has made, Bringing forth wind from His treasures.
135.8: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, From man to beast.
135.9: He sent tokens and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, On Pharaoh and on all his servants.
135.10: Who smote many nations, and slew strong kings,
135.11: Even Sihon king of the Amorite, And Og king of Bashan, And all kingdoms of Canaan.
135.12: And He gave their land an inheritance, An inheritance to Israel His people,
135.13: O Jehovah, Your name is to the age, O Jehovah, Your memorial to all generations.
135.14: For Jehovah does judge His people, And for His servants comforts Himself.
135.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, Work of the hands of man.
135.16: A mouth they have, and they speak not, Eyes they have, and they see not,
135.17: Ears they have, and they give not ear, Nose--there is no breath in their mouth!
135.18: Like them are their makers, Every one who is trusting in them.
135.19: O house of Israel, bless you Jehovah, O house of Aaron, bless you Jehovah,
135.20: O house of Levi, bless you Jehovah, Those fearing Jehovah, bless you Jehovah.
135.21: Blessed is Jehovah from Zion, Inhabiting Jerusalem--praise you Jah!

136.1: Give you thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age is His kindness.
136.2: Give you thanks to the God of gods, For to the age is His kindness.
136.3: Give you thanks to the Lord of lords, For to the age is His kindness.
136.4: To Him doing great wonders by Himself alone, For to the age is His kindness.
136.5: To Him making the heavens by understanding, For to the age is His kindness.
136.6: To Him spreading the earth over the waters, For to the age is His kindness.
136.7: To Him making great lights, For to the age is His kindness.
136.8: The sun to rule by day, For to the age is His kindness.
136.9: The moon and stars to rule by night, For to the age is His kindness.
136.10: To Him smiting Egypt in their first-born, For to the age is His kindness.
136.11: And bringing forth Israel from their midst, For to the age is His kindness.
136.12: By a strong hand, and a stretched-out-arm, For to the age is His kindness.
136.13: To Him cutting the sea of Suph into parts, For to the age is His kindness,
136.14: And caused Israel to pass through its midst, For to the age is His kindness,
136.15: And shook out Pharaoh and his force in the sea of Suph, For to the age is His kindness.
136.16: To Him leading His people in a wilderness, For to the age is His kindness.
136.17: To Him smiting great kings, For to the age is His kindness.
136.18: Yes, He does slay honourable kings, For to the age is His kindness.
136.19: Even Sihon king of the Amorite, For to the age is His kindness.
136.20: And Og king of Bashan, For to the age is His kindness.
136.21: And He gave their land for inheritance, For to the age is His kindness.
136.22: An inheritance to Israel His servant, For to the age is His kindness.
136.23: Who in our lowliness has remembered us, For to the age is His kindness.
136.24: And He delivers us from our adversaries, For to the age is His kindness.
136.25: Giving food to all flesh, For to the age is His kindness.
136.26: Give you thanks to the God of the heavens, For to the age is His kindness!

137.1: By rivers of Babylon--There we did sit, Yes, we wept when we remembered Zion.
137.2: On willows in its midst we hung our harps.
137.3: For there our captors asked us the words of a song, And our spoilers--joy: `Sing you to us of a song of Zion.'
137.4: How do we sing the song of Jehovah, On the land of a stranger?
137.5: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, my right hand forgets!
137.6: My tongue does cleave to my palate, If I do not remember you, If I do not exalt Jerusalem above my chief joy.
137.7: Remember, Jehovah, for the sons of Edom, The day of Jerusalem, Those saying, `Rase, rase to its foundation!'
137.8: O daughter of Babylon, O destroyed one, O the happiness of him who repays to you your deed, That you have done to us.
137.9: O the happiness of him who does seize, And has dashed your sucklings on the rock!

138.1: By David. I confess You, with all my heart, Before the gods I do praise You.
138.2: I bow myself toward Your holy temple, And I confess Your name, For Your kindness, and for Your truth, For You have made great Your saying above all Your name.
138.3: In the day I called, when You do answer me, You do strengthen me in my soul with strength.
138.4: O Jehovah, all kings of earth confess You, When they have heard the sayings of Your mouth.
138.5: And they sing in the ways of Jehovah, For great is the honour of Jehovah.
138.6: For high is Jehovah, and the lowly He sees, And the haughty from afar He knows.
138.7: If I walk in the midst of distress You quicken me, Against the anger of my enemies You send forth Your hand, And Your right hand does save me.
138.8: Jehovah does perfect for me, O Jehovah, Your kindness is to the age, The works of Your hands let not fall!

139.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm by David. Jehovah, You have searched me, and know.
139.2: You--You have known my sitting down, And my rising up, You have attended to my thoughts from afar.
139.3: My path and my couch You have fanned, And with all my ways have been acquainted.
139.4: For there is not a word in my tongue, Indeed, O Jehovah, You have known it all!
139.5: Behind and before You have besieged me, And You do place on me Your hand.
139.6: Knowledge too wonderful for me, It has been set on high, I am not able for it.
139.7: Where do I go from Your Spirit? And where from Your face do I flee?
139.8: If I ascend the heavens--there You are, And spread out a couch in Sheol, indeed, You!
139.9: I take the wings of morning, I dwell in the uttermost part of the sea,
139.10: Also there Your hand does lead me, And Your right hand does hold me.
139.11: And I say, `Surely darkness bruises me, Then night is light to me.
139.12: Also darkness hides not from You, And night as day shines, as is darkness so is light.
139.13: For You--You have possessed my reins, You do cover me in my mother's belly.
139.14: I confess You, because that with wonders I have been distinguished. Wonderful are Your works, And my soul is knowing it well.
139.15: My substance was not hid from You, When I was made in secret, Curiously worked in the lower part of earth.
139.16: My unformed substance Your eyes saw, And on Your book all of them are written, The days they were formed--And not one among them.
139.17: And to me how precious have been Your thoughts, O God, how great has been their sum!
139.18: I recount them! than the sand they are more, I have waked, and I am still with You.
139.19: Do You slay, O God, the wicked? Then, men of blood, turn aside from me!
139.20: Who exchange You for wickedness, Lifted up to vanity are Yours enemies.
139.21: Do not I hate, Jehovah, those hating You? And with Your withstanders grieve myself?
139.22: With perfect hatred I have hated them, Enemies they have become to me.
139.23: Search me, O God, and know my heart, Try me, and know my thoughts,
139.24: And see if a grievous way be in me, And lead me in a way age-during!

140.1: To the Overseer. --A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O Jehovah, from an evil man, From one of violence You keep me.
140.2: Who have devised evils in the heart, All the day they assemble for wars.
140.3: They sharpened their tongue as a serpent, Poison of an adder is under their lips. Selah.
140.4: Preserve me, Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked, From one of violence You keep me, Who have devised to overthrow my steps.
140.5: The proud hid a snare for me--and cords, They spread a net by the side of the path, Snares they have set for me. Selah.
140.6: I have said to Jehovah, `My God are You, Hear, Jehovah, the voice of my supplications.'
140.7: O Jehovah, my Lord, strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of armour.
140.8: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked, His wicked device bring not forth, They are high. Selah.
140.9: The chief of my surrounders, The perverseness of their lips covers them.
140.10: They cause to fall on themselves burning coals, Into fire He does cast them, Into deep pits--they arise not.
140.11: A talkative man is not established in the earth, One of violence--evil hunts to overflowing.
140.12: I have known that Jehovah does execute The judgment of the afflicted, The judgment of the needy.
140.13: Only--the righteous give thanks to Your name, The upright do dwell with Your presence!

141.1: A Psalm, by David. O Jehovah, I have called You, haste to me, Give ear to my voice when I call to You.
141.2: My prayer is prepared--incense before You, The lifting up of my hands--the evening present.
141.3: Set, O Jehovah, a watch for my mouth, Watch You over the door of my lips.
141.4: Incline not my heart to an evil thing, To do habitually actions in wickedness, With men working iniquity, Yes, I eat not of their pleasant things.
141.5: The righteous does beat me in kindness. And does reprove me, Oil of the head my head disallows not, For still my prayer is about their vexations.
141.6: Their judges have been released by the sides of a rock, And they have heard my sayings, For they have been pleasant.
141.7: As one tilling and ripping up in the land, Have our bones been scattered at the command of Saul.
141.8: But to You, O Jehovah, my Lord, are my eyes, In You I have trusted, Make not bare my soul.
141.9: Keep me from the gin they laid for me, Even snares of workers of iniquity.
141.10: The wicked fall in their nets together, till I pass over!

142.1: An Instruction of David, a Prayer when he is in the cave. My voice is to Jehovah, I cry, My voice is to Jehovah, I entreat grace.
142.2: I pour forth before Him my meditation, My distress before Him I declare.
142.3: When my spirit has been feeble in me, Then You have known my path; In the way in which I walk, They have hid a snare for me.
142.4: Looking on the right hand--and seeing, And I have none recognizing; Perished has refuge from me, There is none inquiring for my soul.
142.5: I have cried to you, O Jehovah, I have said, `You are my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.'
142.6: Attend You to my loud cry, For I have become very low, Deliver You me from my pursuers, For they have been stronger than I.
142.7: Bring forth from prison my soul to confess Your name, The righteous do compass me about, When You confer benefits upon me!

143.1: A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, hear my prayer, Give ear to my supplications, In Your faithfulness answer me--in Your righteousness.
143.2: And enter not into judgment with Your servant, For no one living is justified before You.
143.3: For an enemy has pursued my soul, He has bruised to the earth my life, He has caused me to dwell in dark places, As the dead of old.
143.4: And my spirit in me is become feeble, Within me is my heart become desolate.
143.5: I have remembered days of old, I have meditated on all Your acts, On the work of Your hand I muse.
143.6: I have spread forth my hands to You, My soul is as a weary land for You. Selah.
143.7: Haste, answer me, O Jehovah, My spirit has been consumed, Hide not You Your face from me, Or I have been compared with those going down to the pit.
143.8: Cause me to hear in the morning Your kindness, For in You I have trusted, Cause me to know the way that I go, For to You I have lifted up my soul.
143.9: Deliver me from my enemies, O Jehovah, Near You I am covered.
143.10: Teach me to do Your good pleasure, For You are my God--Your Spirit is good, Lead me into a land of uprightness.
143.11: For Your name's sake O Jehovah, You do quicken me, In Your righteousness, You bring out from distress my soul,
143.12: And in Your kindness cut off my enemies, And have destroyed all the adversaries of my soul, For I am Your servant!

144.1: By David. Blessed is Jehovah my rock, who is teaching My hands for war, my fingers for battle.
144.2: My kind one, and my bulwark, My tower, and my deliverer, My shield, and in whom I have trusted, Who is subduing my people under me!
144.3: Jehovah, what is man that You know him? Son of man, that You esteem him?
144.4: Man to vanity has been like, His days are as a shadow passing by.
144.5: Jehovah, incline Your heavens and come down, Strike against mountains, and they smoke.
144.6: Send forth lightning, and scatter them, Send forth Your arrows, and trouble them,
144.7: Send forth Your hand from on high, Free me, and deliver me from many waters, From the hand of sons of a stranger,
144.8: Because their mouth has spoken vanity, And their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
144.9: O God, a new song I sing to You, On a psaltery of ten strings I sing praise to You.
144.10: Who is giving deliverance to kings, Who is freeing David His servant from the sword of evil.
144.11: Free me, and deliver me From the hand of sons of a stranger, Because their mouth has spoken vanity, And their right hand is a right hand of falsehood,
144.12: Because our sons are as plants, Becoming great in their youth, Our daughters as hewn stones, Polished--the likeness of a palace,
144.13: Our garners are full, bringing out from kind to kind, Our flocks are bringing forth thousands, Ten thousands in our out-places,
144.14: Our oxen are carrying, there is no breach, And there is no outgoing, And there is no crying in our broad places.
144.15: O the happiness of the people that is thus, O the happiness of the people whose God is Jehovah!

145.1: Praise by David. I exalt You, my God, O king, And bless Your name to the age and for ever.
145.2: Every day do I bless You, And praise Your name to the age and for ever.
145.3: Great is Jehovah, and praised greatly, And of His greatness there is no searching.
145.4: Generation to generation praises Your works, And Your mighty acts they declare.
145.5: The honour--the glory of Your majesty, And the matters of Your wonders I declare.
145.6: And the strength of Your fearful acts they tell, And Your greatness I recount.
145.7: The memorial of the abundance of Your goodness they send forth. And Your righteousness they sing.
145.8: Gracious and merciful is Jehovah, Slow to anger, and great in kindness.
145.9: Good is Jehovah to all, And His mercies are over all His works.
145.10: Confess You O Jehovah, do all Your works, And Your saints do bless You.
145.11: The honour of Your kingdom they tell, And of Your might they speak,
145.12: To make known to sons of men His mighty acts, The honour of the majesty of His kingdom.
145.13: Your kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, And Your dominion is in all generations.
145.14: Jehovah is supporting all who are falling, And raising up all who are bowed down.
145.15: The eyes of all to You do look, And You are giving to them their food in its season,
145.16: Opening Your hand, and satisfying The desire of every living thing.
145.17: Righteous is Jehovah in all His ways, And kind in all His works.
145.18: Near is Jehovah to all those calling Him, To all who call Him in truth.
145.19: The desire of those fearing Him He does, And their cry He hears, and saves them.
145.20: Jehovah preserves all those loving Him, And all the wicked He destroys.
145.21: The praise of Jehovah my mouth speaks, And all flesh does bless His holy name, To the age and for ever!

146.1: Praise you Jah! Praise, O my soul, Jehovah.
146.2: I praise Jehovah during my life, I sing praise to my God while I exist.
146.3: Trust not in princes--in a son of man, For he has no deliverance.
146.4: His spirit goes forth, he returns to his earth, In that day have his thoughts perished.
146.5: O the happiness of him Who has the God of Jacob for his help, His hope is on Jehovah his God,
146.6: Making the heavens and earth, The sea and all that is in them, Who is keeping truth to the age,
146.7: Doing judgment for the oppressed, Giving bread to the hungry.
146.8: Jehovah is loosing the prisoners, Jehovah is opening (the eyes of) the blind, Jehovah is raising the bowed down, Jehovah is loving the righteous,
146.9: Jehovah is preserving the strangers, The fatherless and widow He causes to stand, And the way of the wicked He turns upside down.
146.10: Jehovah does reign to the age, Your God, O Zion, to generation and generation, Praise you Jah!

147.1: Praise you Jah! For it is good to praise our God, For pleasant--comely is praise.
147.2: Building Jerusalem is Jehovah, The driven away of Israel He gathers.
147.3: Who is giving healing to the broken of heart, And is binding up their griefs.
147.4: Appointing the number of the stars, To all them He gives names.
147.5: Great is our Lord, and abundant in power, Of His understanding there is no narration.
147.6: Jehovah is causing the meek to stand, Making low the wicked to the earth.
147.7: Answer you to Jehovah with thanksgiving, Sing you to our God with a harp.
147.8: Who is covering the heavens with clouds, Who is preparing for the earth rain, Who is causing grass to spring up on mountains,
147.9: Giving to the beast its food, To the young of the ravens that call.
147.10: Not in the might of the horse does He delight, Not in the legs of a man is He pleased.
147.11: Jehovah is pleased with those fearing Him, With those waiting for His kindness.
147.12: Glorify, O Jerusalem, Jehovah, Praise your God, O Zion.
147.13: For He did strengthen the bars of your gates, He has blessed your sons in your midst.
147.14: Who is making your border peace, With the fat of wheat He satisfies You.
147.15: Who is sending forth His saying on earth, Very speedily does His word run.
147.16: Who is giving snow like wool, Hoar-frost as ashes He scatters.
147.17: Casting forth His ice like morsels, Before His cold who does stand?
147.18: He sends forth His word and melts them, He causes His wind to blow--the waters flow.
147.19: Declaring His words to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.
147.20: He has not done so to any nation, As to judgments, they have not known them. Praise you Jah!

148.1: Praise you Jah! Praise you Jehovah from the heavens, Praise you Him in high places.
148.2: Praise you Him, all His messengers, Praise you Him, all His hosts.
148.3: Praise you Him, sun and moon, Praise you Him, all stars of light.
148.4: Praise you Him, heavens of heavens, And you waters that are above the heavens.
148.5: They do praise the name of Jehovah, For He commanded, and they were created.
148.6: And He establishes them for ever to the age, A statute He gave, and they pass not over.
148.7: Praise you Jehovah from the earth, Dragons and all deeps,
148.8: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, Whirlwind doing His word;
148.9: The mountains and all heights, Fruit tree, and all cedars,
148.10: The wild beast, and all cattle, Creeping thing, and winged bird,
148.11: Kings of earth, and all peoples, Chiefs, and all judges of earth,
148.12: Young men, and also maidens, Aged men, with youths,
148.13: They praise the name of Jehovah, For His name alone has been set on high, His honour is above earth and heavens.
148.14: And He exalts the horn of His people, The praise of all His saints, Of the sons of Israel, a people near Him. Praise you Jah!

149.1: Praise you Jah! Sing you to Jehovah a new song, His praise in an assembly of saints.
149.2: Israel does rejoice in his Maker, Sons of Zion do joy in their king.
149.3: They praise His name in a dance, With timbrel and harp sing praise to Him.
149.4: For Jehovah is pleased with His people, He beautifies the humble with salvation.
149.5: Exult do saints in honour, They sing aloud on their beds.
149.6: The exaltation of God is in their throat, And a two-edged sword in their hand.
149.7: To do vengeance among nations, Punishments among the peoples.
149.8: To bind their kings with chains, And their honoured ones with fetters of iron,
149.9: To do among them the judgment written, An honour it is for all his saints. Praise you Jah!

150.1: Praise you Jah! Praise you God in His holy place, Praise Him in the expanse of His strength.
150.2: Praise Him in His mighty acts, Praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.
150.3: Praise Him with blowing of trumpet, Praise Him with psaltery and harp.
150.4: Praise Him with timbrel and dance, Praise Him with stringed instruments and organ.
150.5: Praise Him with cymbals of sounding, Praise Him with cymbals of shouting.
150.6: All that does breathe does praise Jah! Praise you Jah!
